translations.source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.reference: "Sasa tuna panya wenye umri wa miezi minne ambao hawana kisukari ambao awali walikuwa na kisukari", aliongeza.
translations.hypothesis: "Sasa, tuna panya wenye umri wa miezi 4 ambazo hazina ugonjwa wa sukari, wakati awali walikuwa na ugonjwa huo," aliongeza.

translations.source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.reference: Dak. Ehud Ur, profesa wa udaktari katika chuo kikuu cha Dalhousie kule Halifix, Nova Scotia na mwenyekiti wa kitengo cha kliniki na kisayansi kwenye ushirika wa ugonjwa wa kisukari nchini Canada alionya kuwa utafiti bado uko kwenye siku za mapema.
translations.hypothesis: Dato Ehud Ur, profesa wa tiba katika Chuo Kikuu cha Dalhousie huko Halifax, Nova Scotia, na mwenyeki wa idara ya kliniki na ya sayansi ya Shirika la Diabetes la Kanada, amewaonya kwamba utafiti huu bado katika hatua za awali.

translations.source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.reference: Kama wataalam wengine, ana shaka kuhusu kama ugonjwa wa kisukari unaweza kutibiwa, akagundua kuwa matokeo haya hayana umuhimu kwa watu ambao tayari wana ugojwa wa kisukari wa aina 1.
translations.hypothesis: Kama wataalamu wengine, yeye ana shaka kuhusu ikiwa ugonjwa wa diabetes unaweza kutiba, na anasema kwamba matokeo haya si relevant kwa watu ambao tayari wana ugonjwa wa aina ya 1.

translations.source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.reference: Mnamo Jumatatu, Sara Danius, katibu wa kudumu wa Kamati ya Nobel ya Fasihi katika Chuo cha Uswidi, alitangaza hadharani wakati wa kipindi cha redio kwenye Sveriges Radio katika Uswidi kwamba kamati hiyo, kwa kutoweza kumfikia Bob Dylan moja kwa moja kuhusu ushindi wa Tuzo la Nobel la Fasihi 2016, iliacha juhudi zake za kujaribu kumfikia.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo Jumatana, Sara Danius, afisa wa kudumu wa Kamati ya Nobel kwa fasihi katika Taasisi ya Usweden, alitangaza hadharani wakati wa kipindi cha redio kwenye Sveriges Radio nchini Usweden kwamba, kamati, ambayo haikuwa na uwezo wa kuwasiliana moja kwa moja na Bob Dylan kuhusu ushahidi wa Tuzo ya Nobel ya fasihi ya 2016, imetoka katika juhudi zake za kuwasiliana naye.

translations.source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.reference: Danius alisema, "Sasa hivi hatufanyi chochote. Nimepiga simu na kutuma barua pepe kwa mshirika wake wa karibu na kupata majibu ya kirafiki sana. Kwa sasa, hakika hiyo imetosha."
translations.hypothesis: Danius alisema, "Hivi sasa, hatufanyi chochote. Nimeitwa na kuandika barua pepe kwa mshirika wake, na nimepata majibu mazuri sana. Kwa sasa, hilo ni vya kutosha."

translations.source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.reference: Hapo awali, Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Ring, Jamie Siminoff, alitamka kampuni hiyo ilianza wakati kengele yake ya mlangoni haikuwa inasikika katika duka lake kwenye karakana yake.
translations.hypothesis: Hapo awali, Mkurugenzi wa Ring, Jamie Siminoff, alisema kwamba kampuni hiyo ilianza wakati anasisitisha kwamba simu yake haikuwa sauti kutoka kwenye duka lake, ambalo lilikuwa kwenye gari lake.

translations.source: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.reference: Aliunda kengele ya mlango ya Wi-Fi, alisema.
translations.hypothesis: Alibuni kifaa cha simu ambacho hutumia WiFi, alidai.

translations.source: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.reference: Siminoff alisema mauzo yaliongezeka baada ya yeye kuonekana katika kipindi cha Shark Tank mnamo 2013 ambapo paneli ya onyesho hilo ilikataa kufadhili biashara hiyo mpya.
translations.hypothesis: Siminoff alisema kuwa mauzo uliongezeka baada ya kuhudhuria katika kipindi cha "Shark Tank" mnamo 2013, ambapo jopo la programu liliwakataa kutoa fedha kwa kampuni hiyo.

translations.source: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.reference: Baadaye 2017, Siminoff alionekana katika chaneli ya ununuzi ya televisheni QVC.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo mwisho wa 2017, Siminoff alionekana kwenye mtandaoni wa ununuzi, QVC.

translations.source: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.reference: Ring pia alitatua mashtaka ya kampuni pinzani ya usalama, Shirika la ADT.
translations.hypothesis: Ring pia ilipata suluhisho katika kesi ya adhabu na kampuni nyingine ya usalama, ADT Corporation.

translations.source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.reference: Huku chanjo moja ya majaribio ikionekana kupunguza vifo kutokana na Ebola, hadi kufikia sasa, hakuna dawa zimeonyeshwa dhahiri kufaa kutibu maambukizo yaliyoko.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, chanjo moja iliyopimwa inaonekana kuwa na uwezo wa kupunguza vifo vya Ebola, lakini hadi sasa, hakuna dawa ambazo zimeonekana kuwa na ufanisi katika kutibu magonjwa ya Ebola.

translations.source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.reference: Kinywaji kimoja cha kingamwili, ZMapp, hapo awali kilionyesha ahadi uwanjani, lakini tafiti rasmi zilionyesha kilikuwa na faida kidogo kuliko ilivyotafutwa katika kuzuia kifo.
translations.hypothesis: Moja ya maji ya protina, ZMapp, ilionyesha matumaini katika eneo hilo, lakini utafiti rasmi ilionyesha kuwa hakikuwa na faida kubwa katika kuzuia vifo, kama ilivyotarajiwa.

translations.source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.reference: Katika jaribio la PALM, Zmapp ilitumika kama kidhibiti, kumaanisha wanasayansi waliitumia kama msingi na kulinganisha matibabu mengine matatu nayo.
translations.hypothesis: Katika jaribio la PALM, ZMapp ilitumika kama kiwango, kumaanisha kwamba wataalamu walitumia kama mbadala na kulinganisha matibabu mengine tatu na yeye.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics hukubali barua ya Kamati ya Olimpiki ya Marekani na hukubali hitaji kuu la familia ya Olimpiki la kukuza mazingira salama kwa wanariadha wetu wote.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics inakubali barua ya Kamati ya Olimpiki ya Marekani na inaamini kuwa ni muhimu sana kwamba familia ya Olimpiki kuhakikisha mazingira salama kwa wataalamu wote.

translations.source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.reference: Tunakubaliana na taarifa ya USOC kwamba masilahi ya wanariadha na vilabu vyetu, na spoti yao, huenda yakashughulikiwa vyema kwa kusonga mbele na mabadiliko ya maana ndani ya shirika letu, badala ya kughairi vyeti.
translations.hypothesis: Tunakubaliana na tangazo la USOC kwamba, maslahi ya wataalamu na klabu zetu, pamoja na michezo yao, yanaweza kupatikana vizuri zaidi kwa kuendelea na mabadiliko muhimu ndani ya shirika letu, badala ya kufuta leseni.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics inaunga mkono uchunguzi huru ambao labda utafafanua jinsi unyanyasaji wa kiwango kama vile ulivyoelezewa kwa ujasiri sana na manusura wa Larry Nassar ungekosa kugunduliwa kwa muda mrefu hivyo na inakumbatia mabadiliko muhimu na ya kufaa.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics inasaidizi uchunguzi wa moja kwa moja ambao unaweza kuonyesha jinsi matumizi mabaya yaliyotajwa kwa ujasiri na wahudumu wa Larry Nassar yanaweza kuwa bila kugunduliwa kwa muda mrefu, na pia yanaamini katika mabadiliko muhimu na sahihi.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.reference: USA Gymnastics na USOC zina lengo moja — kuifanya spoti ya sarakasi, na nyingine, salama iwezekanavyo ili wanariadha wafuate ndoto zao katika mazingira salama, chanya na ya kuwezesha.
translations.hypothesis: USA Gymnastics na USOC wana lengo moja — kuwezesha michezo ya gymnastics, na michezo zingine, kuwa salama iwezekanavyo kwa wanamchezo, ili waweze kufanikisha malengo yao katika mazingira salama, chanya na yenye nguvu.

translations.source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.reference: Katika miaka yote ya 1960, Brzezinski alimfanyia kazi John F. Kennedy kama mshauri wake na pia utawala wa Lyndon B. Johnson.
translations.hypothesis: Katika miaka ya 1960, Brzezinski alifanya kazi kwa John F. Kennedy kama mshauri, na baadaye katika serikali ya Lyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: Wakati wa uteuzi wa 1976, alimshauri Carter kuhusu sera ya nje, kisha akafanya kazi kama Mshauri wa Usalama wa Kitaifa (NSA) kutoka 1977 hadi 1981, na alichukua hatamu kutoka kwa Henry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: wakati wa uchaguzi wa 1976, aliuongoza Carter katika masuala ya mzozo wa kigeni, na baadaye alihudumu kama Mshauri wa Kitaifa wa Usalama (NSA) kuanzia 1977 hadi 1981, baada ya Henry Kissinger.

translations.source: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: Kama NSA, alimsaidia Carter katika kushughulikia masuala ya dunia kidiplomasia, kama vile Mikataba ya Kambi David, 1978; kurekebisha uhusiano wa Marekani na China mwishoni mwa miaka ya 1970; Mapinduzi ya Irani, ambayo yalipelekea janga la mateka la Irani, 1979; na shambulio la Kisovyeti katika Afganistani, 1979.
translations.hypothesis: Kama mshauri wa NSA, alisaidia Carter katika usimamizi wa masuala ya kimataifa, kama vile Makubaliano ya Camp David, 1978; kuimarisha uhusiano kati ya Marekani na China katika mwisho wa miaka ya 1970; Mapinduzi ya Iran, ambayo yalizua mgogoro wa makabudi katika Iran, 1979; na uvamizi wa Sovieti nchini Afghanistan, 1979.

translations.source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.reference: Sinema, iliyoshirikisha Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone ilipata uteuzi katika kategoria zote kuu.
translations.hypothesis: Filamu hiyo, ambayo ina staili za Ryan Gosling na Emma Stone, ilipata nominatio katika matahiri kuu.

translations.source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.reference: Gosling na Stone walipokea uteuzi wa Muigizaji na Mwigizaji wa kike Bora mtawalia.
translations.hypothesis: Gosling na Stone walipokea nominatio za "Mwigizaji Bora" na "Mwigizaji Bora" kwao.

translations.source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.reference: Uteuzi mwingine unahusisha Picha, Mwelekezi, Sinema, Muundo wa Mavazi, Uhariri wa Filamu, Alama ya Asili, Muundo wa Uzalishaji, Uhariri wa Sauti, Uchanganyaji wa Sauti na Mchezo Halisi wa Skrini Bora.
translations.hypothesis: Nominations zingine ni pamoja na: Picha Bora, Mkurugenzi, Uandishi wa Picha, Ubunifu wa Wigo, Uandishi wa Picha, Muziki Asili, Ubunifu wa Uchoraji, Uandishi wa Sauti, Uchanganyaji wa Saidi, na Uandishi wa Picha Asili.

translations.source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.reference: Nyimbo mbili kutoka kwa sinema, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) na Mji wa Nyota, zilipendekezwa kuwa nyimbo bora asilia. Studio ya Lionsgate ilipendekezwa mara 26 – zaidi ya studio nyingine yoyote.
translations.hypothesis: Mbuni wawili kutoka kwenye filamu, "Audition (The Fools Who Dream)" na "City of Stars," zimepata nominatio za "imbo bora asilia". Studio ya Lionsgate ilipata nominatio 26 – zaidi kuliko studio yoyote nyingine.

translations.source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.reference: Mwishoni mwa Jumapili, Rais wa Marekani Donald Trump, katika taarifa iliyowasilishwa kupitia katibu wa uandishi wa habari, alitangaza kwamba vikosi vya Marekani vitaondoka Siria.
translations.hypothesis: Jumamosi, Rais wa Marekani, Donald Trump, kupitia kwa msemaji wa serikali, alitangaza kuwa askari wa Marekani wataondoka Syria.

translations.source: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.reference: Tangazo lilifanywa baada ya Trump kuwa na mazungumzo ya simu na Rais wa Uturuki Recep Tayyip Erdogan.
translations.hypothesis: Taarifa hiyo ilitolewa baada ya Trump kuwa na mazungumzo kupitia simu na Rais wa Turkey, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

translations.source: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.reference: Uturuki ilikua yachukua ulinzi wa wapiganaji wa ISIS waliotekwa ambao, tangazo lilisema kuwa, nchi za Ulaya zilikataa kurudi.
translations.hypothesis: Turkey pia itakuwa na jukumu la kuwajibisha askari wa ISIS waliopandishwa, ambayo, kwa taarifa hiyo, mataifa ya Ulaya amekataa kuwarudisha.

translations.source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.reference: Hii haithibitishi tu kuwa baadhi ya dinosaria walikuwa na manyoya, nadharia ambayo tayari imezagaa, bali pia inatoa maelezo ambayo kijumla visukuku haviwezi, kama vile rangi na mpangilio wa pande-tatu.
translations.hypothesis: Hii si tu hakikisha kwamba angalau baadhi ya dinosauri walikuwa na nyasi, ambayo ni wazo amepokelewa, lakini pia inatoa maelezo ambayo madukudu kwa kawaida hawawezi, kama vile rangi na muundo wa tatu.

translations.source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.reference: . Wanasayansi wanasema manyoya ya mnyama huyu yalikuwa ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu upande wa juu na hafifu au rangi ya karotini upande wa chini.
translations.hypothesis: . Wataalamu wanasema kwamba ngozi ya kitani hiki ilikuwa kahawia-caramel kwenye uso, na kwenye mstari wa chini ilikuwa ya rangi hafifu au rangi ya carotenoid.

translations.source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.reference: Utambuzi huo pia unatoa ufahamu wa mageuko ya manyoya katika ndege.
translations.hypothesis: Ukitutumia pia, unaweza kupata ufahamu kuhusu maendeleo ya nyasi kwa wadumbu.

translations.source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.reference: Kwa sababu manyoya ya dinosau hayana chimbuko uliyostawishwa vizuri, inayoitwa rachi, lakini huwa na sifa zingine za manyoya — barbu na barbule — watafiti waligundua rachi labda ni maendeleo ya baadaye ya uvumbuzi kuliko sifa hizi nyingine.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa sababu surai za dinosauri hazina sura thabiti, inayoitwa "rachis," lakini zina vigeuzi vingine vya surai—barbs na barbules—, watafiti wameghairi kwamba "rachis" ilikuwa maendeleo ya baadaye ambayo vigeuzi hivi.

translations.source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Muundo wa manyoya unaonyesha kwamba hayakutumika katika kupeperuka bali yalitumiwa kudhibiti joto au uonyesho. Watafiti walipendekeza kwamba, ingawa huu ni mkia wa dinosauri mchanga, sampuli inaonyesha manyoya ya utu uzima na si manyoya laini ya ndani ya kifaranga.
translations.hypothesis: Muundo wa nyasi zinaonyesha kwamba haziku matumika kwa ndege, bali kwa kudhibiti joto au kuonyesha. Watafiti wamesema kwamba, licha ya kwamba hii ni nyasi za kizuio, sampuli inaonyesha nyasi za wadau, si nyasi za mbwa.

translations.source: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Watafiti walipendekeza kwamba, hata kama huu ni mkia wa dinosau mdogo, sampuli hiyo inaonyesha manyoya ya ukubwa na si manyoya ya kifaranga mdogo.
translations.hypothesis: Watafiti wameshauri kwamba, licha ya kuwa hii ni nywele za dinosauri mdogo, sampuli inaonyesha nywele za mtu, si nywele za mbwa.

translations.source: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.reference: Bomu la gari lililolipuliwa katika hedikota ya polisi katika Gaziantep, Uturuki jana asubuhi liliwaua maafisa wawili wa polisi na kuwajeruhi watu wengine zaidi ya ishirini.
translations.hypothesis: Kituo cha polisi katika Gaziantep, Турки, kilipatikana na bomu jana asubuhi, na kusababisha vifo vya maafisa wawili na kuumia zaidi ya watu wa kumi.

translations.source: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.reference: Ofisi ya Gavana ilisema kumi na tisa wa wale waliojeruhiwa walikuwa maafisa wa polisi.
translations.hypothesis: Ofisi ya govenor ilitangaza kwamba kumi na tisa wa majeruhi ni maafisa polisi.

translations.source: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.reference: Polisi walisema wanashuku wanaodaiwa kuwa wanamgambo wa Daesh (ISIL) kwa kuhusika na shambulio hilo.
translations.hypothesis: Polisi wamesema kwamba wana shaka kuwa mtu anayewahi kuwa mwanamshangao wa Daesh (ISIL) ni muuaji wa huyu.

translations.source: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.reference: Walipata kuwa Jua lilifanya kazi kwa kanuni msingi sawa na za nyota nyingine: Shuguli za nyota zote kwenye mfumo zilipatikana kuendeshwa na mng'ao wao, mzunguko wao na hakuna jingine.
translations.hypothesis: Walisitisha kwamba Jua hufanya kazi kwa mbinu sawa na nyota zingine: Imepatikana kwamba shughuli za nyota zote katika mfumo zinalenga kwa uwazi, kwa kasi, na hakuna chochote kingine.

translations.source: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.reference: Mng'ao na mzunguko hutumika pamoja ili kuamua namba ya Rossby ya nyota, ambayo inahusiana na mtiririko wa utegili.
translations.hypothesis: Nuru na mzunguko hutumika pamoja ili kuamua idadi Rossby ya nyota, ambayo ni uhusiano na mzunguko wa nyuklia.

translations.source: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.reference: Jinsi idadi ya Rossby inavyokuwa ndogo, ndivyo nyota zinapungua kuwa wa utendaji kwa kuzingatia mabadiliko ya sumaku.
translations.hypothesis: Je, Rossby number ni ndogo, basi nyota hiyo huwa chini ya shughuli, kuliko mabadiliko ya magundu.

translations.source: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.reference: Wakati wa safari yake, Iwasaki alikumbwa na matata mara nyingi.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati wa safari yake, Iwasaki alikumbana na matatizo kadhaa.

translations.source: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.reference: Aliporwa na maharamia, akashambuliwa huko Tibeti na mbwa mwenye kichaa, akakwepa ndoa katika Nepali na akakamatwa huko India.
translations.hypothesis: Alipatikana na wahasarishaji, alishambuliwa katika Tibet na mbwa mwenye magonjwa, alikimbia harusi nchini Nepal, na alishukiwa na polisi nchini India.

translations.source: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.reference: Kiwango cha 802.11n hufanya kazi katika masafa ya gigahezi 2.4 na gigahezi 5.0.
translations.hypothesis: Mbadala wa 802.11n hufanya kazi kwenye freqa za 2.4GHz na 5.0GHz.

translations.source: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.reference: Hii itaiwezesha kutangamana kwa nyuma na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g, mradi tu kituo cha ardhini kina redio mbili.
translations.hypothesis: Hii itaruhusu kuwa na umaridadi na 802.11a, 802.11b na 802.11g, ikiwa stesheni kuu ina radio mbili.

translations.source: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: Kasi za 802.11n ni haraka sana kuliko zile za watangulizi wake zikiwa upeo wa kinadharia wa kiwango cha juu cha 600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: Kasi za 802.11n ni kubwa zaidi kuliko zile za mifano iliyopita, na ina uwezo wa kiwanda wa hadi 600Mbit/s.

translations.source: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.reference: Duvall, ambaye ameolewa na ana watoto waliokomaa, hakuacha hisia kubwa kwa Miller, ambayehadithi ilimhusu.
translations.hypothesis: Duvall, ambaye ni mama na ana watoto wawili, hakuwa na athari kubwa kwa Miller, ambaye alisoma hadithi hiyo.

translations.source: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.reference: Alipoambiwa atoe maoni, Miller alisema, "Mike huongea sana wakati wa kesi…nilikuwa najitayarisha kwa hivyo sikuwa ninasikia kwa kweli alichokuwa akisema."
translations.hypothesis: Alipoulizwa kuhusu mada hiyo, Miller alisema, "Mike anazungumzia sana wakati wa majibisho... Mimi nilikuwa napanga, hivyo kwamba si na kusikiliza vizuri kile alichosema."

translations.source: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.reference: "Tutajaribu kupunguza utoaji wa dayoksidi ya kaboni kwa kila kipimo cha GDP kwa kiwango muhimu kufikia 2020 kutoka kiwango cha 2005", Hu alisema.
translations.hypothesis: "Sitatumahuli lengo la kupunguza emisia za dioksidi ya kaboni kwa kiwango cha kwanza, kwa wastani, hadi 2020, kutoka kiwango cha 2005," Hu alisema.

translations.source: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.reference: Hakuweka kiwango cha kukatwa, akisema itafanywa kulingana na pato la kiuchumi la China.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuweka kiwango mahsusi kwa punguzo, akisema kuwa punguzo zitafanyika kulingana na uzalishaji wa kiuchumi wa China.

translations.source: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.reference: Hu aliimiza nchi zinazokua “kuepuka njia ya kitambo ya kuchafua kwanza na kusafisha baadaye.’’
translations.hypothesis: Hu alishawahi kuwasihi nchi zinazotaendelea "kuogopa njia ya zamani ya kuleta uchafuzi kwanza na kuondoa baadaye."

translations.source: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.reference: Aliongeza kwamba "hawapaswi, hata hivyo, kuombwa kuchukua wajibu ambao ni zaidi ya hatua yao ya ukuaji, uwajibikaji na uwezo."
translations.hypothesis: Aliongeza kwamba, "lakini, haipaswi kuwaomba kukamilisha majukumu ambayo zaidi ya hatua yao ya maendeleo, majukumu yao, na uwezo wao."

translations.source: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.reference: Kikundi cha Wasomi wa Iraq kiliwasilisha ripoti yao saa 12 GMT leo.
translations.hypothesis: Kikundi cha utafiti kuhusu Iraq kilitolea ripoti zao saa 12.00 za saa za dunia (GMT) leo.

translations.source: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.reference: Inatoa ilani kwamba hakuna yeyote anayeweza kutoa hakikisho kwamba mpango wowote wa hatua katika Iraki wakati huu utakomesha vita vya kimadhehebu, vurugu inayozidi, au mwelekeo kwenye machafuko.
translations.hypothesis: Hii inaonya kwamba hakuna mtu ambaye anaweza kuhakikisha kuwa, katika hali hii, hakuna hatua ambayo itazima vita vya dini, uadui, au hatari ya kuathiri katika utata.

translations.source: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.reference: Ripoti hiyo inaanza kwa ombi la mjadala wazi na kuundwa kwa maafikiano katika Marekani kuhusu sera kuhusu Mashariki ya Kati.
translations.hypothesis: Taratibu hii ina maombi kwa mjadala wazi na kuunda maazimio katika Marekani kuhusu sera kuhusu Mashariki ya Kati.

translations.source: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.reference: Ripoti hiyo inashutumu vikali karibu kila kipengele cha sera ya sasa ya Mtendaji kuhusu Iraki na inahimiza ubadilishaji wa mwelekeo mara moja.
translations.hypothesis: Taratibu ina ukosoaji mkubwa kwa kila upande wa sera ya utawala kuelekea Iraq, na inatoa ombi la mabadiliko ya haraka.

translations.source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.reference: Kwanza kati ya mapendekezo yake 78 ni kwamba mpango mpya wa kidiplomasia unapaswa kuchukuliwa kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka huu ili kuweka katika hali ya usalama mipaka ya Iraq dhidi ya uingiliaji wa maadui na kuanzisha tena uhusiano wa kidiplomasia na majirani zake.
translations.hypothesis: Kwanza, kati ya mapendekezo 78, ni kwamba inafanywa mradi mpya wa kidiplomasia kabla ya mwisho wa mwaka huu ili kulinda mipaka ya Iraq dhidi ya mashambulizi, na kuweka tena uhusiano wa kidiplomasia na nchi jirani.

translations.source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Seneta wa sasa na Mke wa Rais wa Ajentina Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner alitangaza uwaniaji wake wa urais jana jioni katika La Plata, mji ulio kilomita 50 (maili 31) kutoka Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: Seneta wa sasa na Mke wa Kwanza wa Argentina, Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner, alitangaza kampeni yake ya urais jana jioni katika La Plata, jiji ambalo kina umbali wa kilomita 50 (mialini na moja) kutoka Buenos Aires.

translations.source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.reference: Bi. Kirchner alitangaza nia yake ya kuwania urais katika Ukumbi wa Ajentina, mahali pale pale alipotumia kuanzisha kampeni yake ya Seneti mnamo 2005 kama memba wa ujumbe wa wilaya ya Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: Bwana Kirchner alitangaza nia yake ya kuwania urais katika Teatri la Argentina, eneo ambalo pia alitumia kuanza kampeni yake ya 2005 kwa nafasi ya mwanachama wa kikundi cha Buenos Aires.

translations.source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.reference: Mjadala ulianzishwa na mzozo juu ya kutumia zaidi kwa msaada na ujenzi upya katika Kimbunga Katrina; ambacho wahafidhina wa fedha wabebandika kwa ucheshi “Mpango wa Bushwa New Orleans.”
translations.hypothesis: Debati ilianzishwa kutokana na kontrozi kuhusu matumizi ya misaada na ujenaji baada ya ajali kubwa ya Katrina; ambayo baadhi ya watahadharishia wamewahi kuitaja "Mkataba wa Bush katika New Orleans."

translations.source: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.reference: Ukosoaji huru wa juhudi za ujenzi upya umezingatia utoaji wa kandarasi za ujenzi upya kwa wajuzi wanaodhaniwa wa Washington.
translations.hypothesis: Maoni ya kibofu kuhusu juhudi za ujenaji, yamezungumzia zaidi kuhusu uagaji wa mkataba za ujenaji kwa watu wanaodhaniwa kuwa wana uhusiano na serikali ya Marekani.

translations.source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.reference: Watu zaidi ya milioni nne walienda Roma kuhudhuria mazishi.
translations.hypothesis: Kimsingi, milioni nne za watu walitembelea Roma ili kuhudhuria mazishi.

translations.source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.reference: Idadi ya watu waliokuwepo ilikuwa kubwa sana kwamba haikuwezekana kwa kila mtu kupata kuingia kwenye mazishi katika uwanja wa St. Peter.
translations.hypothesis: Idadi ya watu waliohudhuria ilikuwa kubwa sana, hivyo kwamba haikuwa rahisi kwa kila mtu kupata nafasi katika mazishi katika eneo la St. Peter.

translations.source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.reference: Skrini kadhaa kubwa za televisheni ziliangikwa mahali mbalimbali jijini Roma ili kuwezesha watu kutazama sherehe hiyo.
translations.hypothesis: Vifaa vya runinga kubwa vilikuwa imejengwa katika maeneo mbalimbali mjini Roma ili watu waweze kuangalia sherehe.

translations.source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.reference: Katika miji mingine mingi ya Italia na ulimwengu kwa ujumla, haswa katika Polandi, mipangilio sawa ilifanywa, ambayo ilionekana na idadi kubwa ya watu.
translations.hypothesis: Katika miji mingine nyingi nchini Italia na katika dunia nzima, hasa nchini Poland, miundombinu kama hiyo iloendelezwa, na iligunduliwa na idadi kubwa ya watu.

translations.source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.reference: Wanahistoria wameshutumu sera za zamani za FBI kwa kuangazia rasilimali kwenye kesi ambazo ni rahisi kutatua, hasa kesi za magari yaliyoibwa, kwa madhumuni ya kuongeza kiwango cha mafanikio cha wakala.
translations.hypothesis: Wahandisi wamemtetea sera za zamani za FBI kwa kuwa ziliwezesha kuwezesha rasilimali kwenye kesi ambazo ni rahisi kutatua, haswa kesi za magari iliyoibiwa, kwa lengo la kuongeza ufanisi wa taasisi hiyo.

translations.source: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.reference: Bunge lilianza kufadhili kikundi chenye nia chafu katika mwaka wa kifedha wa 2005 na kuaini kuwa FBI lazima itoe makachero kumi kwa ponografia ya watu wazima.
translations.hypothesis: Bunge kuanza kutoa fedha kwa kampeni hiyo katika mwaka wa fedha wa 2005, na wameeleza kwamba FBI lazima wajitokeza na maafisa 10 kwa ajili ya pornografi kwa watu wazima.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.reference: Robin Uthappa alifanya alama za juu za fursa, pointi 70 katika mipira 41 kwa kufikia nne 11 na sita 2.
translations.hypothesis: Robin Uthappa alifanya alipata alama za juu zaidi katika mechi, 70 runs katika dakika 41 tu, kwa kufunga 11 goals na 2 homers.

translations.source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.reference: Wachezaji wa kati wa kriketi, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid, walicheza vizuri na kushirikiana katika masafa mia moja.
translations.hypothesis: Wachezaji wa timu ya kati, Sachin Tendulkar na Rahul Dravid, alicheza vizuri na ulianza ushirikiano wa runi 100.

translations.source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.reference: Lakini, baada ya kupoteza wiketi ya kapteni India ilifanya pointi 36 na kupoteza wiketi 7 kumaliza fursa.
translations.hypothesis: Lakini, baada ya kupoteza wicket ya kipalo, India ilifanya tu runs 36, na ikipoteza wickets 7, ili kumalizia mchezo.

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.reference: Rais wa Marekani George W. Bush alifika Singapori asubuhi ya Novemba 16, hivyo kuanza ziara ya Asia ya wiki moja.
translations.hypothesis: Rais wa Marekani, George W. Bush, alifika nchini Singapore mchana wa 16 Novemba, na kuanza safari ya wiki moja katika Asia.

translations.source: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: Alisalimiwa na Naibu Waziri Mkuu wa Singapori Wong Kan Seng na wakajadili masuala ya biashara na ughaidi na Waziri Mkuu wa Singapori Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: Alikaribishwa na Waziri Mkuu wa Singapore, Wong Kan Seng, na alizungumzia masuala ya biashara na ugaidi na Waziri Mkuu wa Singapore, Lee Hsien Loong.

translations.source: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.reference: Baada ya wiki ya kushindwa katika uchaguzi wa nusu muhula, Bush aliambia hadhira kuhusu upanuzi wa biashara katika Asia.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya wiki moja ya hasara katika uchaguzi wa katikati, Bush alizungumzia kuhusu ongezeko la biashara katika Asia.

translations.source: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.reference: Waziri Mkuu Stephen Harper amekubali kutuma ‘Mkataba wa Hewa Safi’ wa serikali kwa kamati ya vyama vyote kwa ukaguzi, kabla ya kusomwa kwake kwa mara ya pili, baada ya mkutano wa Jumanne wa dakika 25 na kiongozi wa NDP Jack Layton kwenye PMO.
translations.hypothesis: Mkurugenzi Mkuu Stephen Harper amekubaliana kutuma "Kanuni ya Hawa za Hewa" ya serikali kwa kamati ya vyama vyote ili kukagua, kabla ya kusomwa kwa mara ya pili, baada ya mkutano wa dakika 25 na mwenyekiti wa NDP, Jack Layton, katika ofisi ya Mkurugenzi Mkuu.

translations.source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.reference: Layton alikuwa ameomba mabadiliko ya mswada wa kimazingira wa wahafidhina wakati wa mkutano na PM, akiomba “uandishi upya wa undani na mkamilifu” wa mswada wa kimazingira wa chama cha Wahafidhina.
translations.hypothesis: Layton alitaka mabadiliko katika wito wa chama cha upinzani kuhusu masuala ya mazingira, akitaka "kuandika upya" wito wa chama cha upinzani kuhusu masuala ya mazingira.

translations.source: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.reference: Tangu Serikali ya Shirikisho ilipoingilia kati kuhusu ufadhili wa hospitali ya Mersey katika Davenport, Tasmania, serikali ya jimbo na baadhi ya wabunge wa shirikisho wameshutumu kitendo hiki kama sarakasi kabla ya uchaguzi wa kishirika utakaofanyika mnamo Novemba.
translations.hypothesis: Tangu serikali ya kitaifa ilipoingilia kati na kuchukua jukumu la kuendesha hospitali ya Mersey huko Devonport, Tasmania, serikali ya eneo na baadhi ya wawakilishi wa serikali wameonya kuhusu hatua hii kama ni jitihada za awali kwa uchaguzi wa kitaifa ambao utafanyika mwezi Novemba.

translations.source: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.reference: Lakini Waziri Mkuu John Howard alisema kitendo hicho kilikuwa tu cha kulinda majengo ya hospitali kutokana na kushushwa hadhi na serikali ya Tasmania, kwa kutoa dola milioni 45 za Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Lakini, Waziri Mkuu John Howard amesema kuwa, matendo hayo yalikuwa kwa lengo la kujilinda hospitali kutoka kwa kupunguzwa na serikali ya Tasmania, baada ya kupokea fedha za ziada za AUD$45 milioni.

translations.source: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.reference: Kulingana na taarifa za hivi punde, vipimo vya kiwango cha bahari vilionyesha tufani ilizalishwa. Kulikuwa na baadhi ya shughuli dhahiri za tufani zilizorekodiwa karibu na Pago Pago na Niue.
translations.hypothesis: Kulingana na taarifa za hivi majuzi, upisaji wa viwango vya bahari ilionyesha kwamba mgongano (tsunami) ulitokea. Kuna shughuli za mgongano ambazo zimeelezwa karibu na Pago Pago na Niue.

translations.source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.reference: Hakuna madhara makubwa au majeraha yaliyoripotiwa huko Tonga, lakini nguvu za umeme zilipotea kwa muda, hali ambayo iliripotiwa kuzuia mamlaka ya Tongan kupokea onyo la tsunami lililotolewa na PTWC.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuna uharibifu kubwa au majeraha yaliyo taarifa katika Tonga, lakini umeme ulipotea kwa muda, ambapo kimsingi, maafisa wa Tonga hawakuweza kupokea tangazo la dhoruba kubwa la PTWC.

translations.source: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.reference: Shule kumi na nne katika Hawaii zilizoko au zilizo karibu na mipaka ya pwani zilifungwa siku nzima Jumatano licha ya tahadhari kuondolewa.
translations.hypothesis: Shule 14 katika Hawaii, ambazo ziko au karibu na mipingo, zilifungwa siku ya Jumatano, licha ya kuwa tangazo la kufungua shule limefuta.

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.reference: Rais wa marekani George W. Bush alikaribisha tangazo hilo.
translations.hypothesis: Rais wa Marekani, George W. Bush, alikaribisha tangazo hilo.

translations.source: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.reference: Msemaji wa Bush Gordon Johndroe alitaja ahadi ya Korea Kaskazini kama “hatua kuu kuelekea lengo la kufikia uondoaji wa kuaminika wa silaha za kinyuklia katika rasi ya Kikorea.”
translations.hypothesis: Spika wa serikali, Gordon Johndroe, alitaja ahadi ya Korea Kaskazini kuwa "hatua kubwa kuelekea kwenye lengo la kufikia uondoaji wa silaha za nyuklia katika peninsula ya Korea."

translations.source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.reference: Dhoruba ya kumi iliyopewa jina ya msimu wa Kimbunga cha Atlantiki, Dhoruba ya Nusutropiki ya Jerry, iliundwa katika Bahari ya Atlantiki leo.
translations.hypothesis: 暴풍 يحمل jina la kumi katika msimu wa dhoruba za Bahari ya Atlantiki, dhoruba ya Subtropical Jerry, iliyoundwa katika Bahari ya Atlantiki leo.

translations.source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.reference: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Vimbunga (NHC) kinasema kwamba wakati huu, Jerry hakitoi tishio kwa ardhi.
translations.hypothesis: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Majira ya Halali (NHC) kinaeleza kwamba, katika hatua hii, Jerry hatuepuka.

translations.source: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.reference: Corps of Engineers cha Marekani kilikadiria kwamba inchi 6 za mvua huenda zikabomoa matuta ambayo yaliharibiwa awali.
translations.hypothesis: Serikali ya Marekani, kupitia idara ya uhandisi, ilitathmini kwamba, mvua ya sentimeti 6 inaweza kuvunja eneo lililoharibika hapo awali.

translations.source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.reference: Wadi ya Tisa, ambayo ilishuhudia mafuriko ya hadi futi 20 kwa kimo wakati wa Kimbunga Katrina, sasa iko kwenye maji yanayofikia kiunoni kwani tuta lililokuwa karibu lilifurika.
translations.hypothesis: Sehemu ya tisa, ambayo ilipata maji hadi urefu wa futi 20 wakati wa dhoruba ya Katrina, kwa sasa iko kwenye maji hadi mid ya, baada ya eneo lenye kizuizi (levee) karibu kupatikana.

translations.source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.reference: Maji yanamwagika juu ya tuta katika sehemu ya futi 100 upana.
translations.hypothesis: Maji yana kutoka nje ya kuta, katika eneo lenye urefu wa futi 100.

translations.source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.reference: Msimamizi wa Commons Adam Cuerden alielezea kufadhaika kwake kuhusu ufutaji huo alipoongea na Wikinews mwezi uliopita.
translations.hypothesis: Msimamizi wa "Commons" Adam Cuerden alionyesha wasiwasi wake kuhusu upigaji, wakati alipozungumzia na Wikinews mwezi uliopita.

translations.source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.reference: "Yeye [Wales] kimsingi alindanganya tangu mwanzo. Kwanza kwa kufanya kama hii ni kwa sababu za kisheria. Pili, kwa kujifanya alikuwa anatusikiliza, hadi saana yake ifutwe."
translations.hypothesis: "Yeye [Wales] kwa kweli alituambia uongo tangu mwanzo. Kwanza, kwa kuonyesha kwamba hii ilikuwa kwa sababu za kisheria. Pili, kwa kuonekana kwamba alisikiliza, hata hadi alipohama kazi zake."

translations.source: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.reference: Hasira ya jamii imesababisha juhudi za sasa za kutayarisha sera kuhusu kadiri ya ngono kwa wavuti ambayo inakaribisha mamilioni ya vyombo vya habari vilivyo na leseni wazi.
translations.hypothesis: Mfiduo katika jamii lilipelekea juhudi za sasa za kuandaa sera kuhusu maudhui za kiafya kwenye tovuti ambayo ina maudhui milioni za za wazi.

translations.source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.reference: Kazi iliyofanywa ilikuwa hasa ya nadharia, lakini programu ilitengenezwa ili kuiga mitazamo iliyofanywa ya galaksi ya Mshale.
translations.hypothesis: Kazi ilifanyika kwa kiasi kubwa, lakini programu ilikuwa imekusudiwa kuiga mashtaka yaliyopatikana kuhusu galaksi ya Sagittarius.

translations.source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.reference: Athari ambayo timu ilikuwa ikitafuta ingesababishwa na nguvu za mawimbi baina ya dutu nyeusi za galaksia na dutu nyeusi za Kilimia.
translations.hypothesis: تأثير ambapo timu ilitafuta utakuwa unaasababishwa na nguvu za mizuri kati ya nyenzo hatua za galaksi na nyenzo hatua za sayari ya Milky Way.

translations.source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.reference: Kama vile mwezi unavuta nguvu duniani, na kusababisha mawimbi, vivyo hivyo ndivyo Njia ya Kimaziwa hutia nguvu kwenye giligili la alama ya Mshale.
translations.hypothesis: Kama mwezi huathiri dunia, na kusababisha maji, hivyo pia, galaksi ya Sagittarius inathiri na mvuto wa Milky Way.

translations.source: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
translations.reference: Wanasayansi waliweza kuhitimisha kuwa udusi mweusi unaathiri udusi mwingine mweusi kwa njia ile ile ya kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: Watafiti walifanikiwa kufikia hitimisho kwamba, nyenzo isiyoonekana zinaathiri nyenzo zingine isiyoonekana kwa njia sawa na nyenzo za kawaida.

translations.source: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.reference: Nadharia hii inasema kuwa dutu nyingi yenye giza inayozingira galaksi iko karibu na galaksi kwa aina ya mwangaza, na inatengenezwa kwa chembechembe nyingi ndogo.
translations.hypothesis: Hatao hili linaonyesha kwamba karibu kwa galaksi, karibu kwa aina ya "halo", kuna jambo lisiloonekana, na lina undugu za vidogo nyingi.

translations.source: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.reference: Ripoti kwenye televisheni zinaonyesha moshi mweupe unaotoka kwenye mmea huo.
translations.hypothesis: Taarifa za televisheni zinaonyesha sigara nyeupe inayotoka kutoka kwenye kiwanda.

translations.source: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.reference: Mamlaka ya ndani inaonya wakaaji walio karibu na mmea huo kukaa ndani, kuzima viyoyozi na kutokunywa maji ya bomba.
translations.hypothesis: Vituo vya serikali vinaonya wakazi walio karibu na kiwanda kuhifadhi ndani, kuzima vifurushi vya maji, na kuepuka kunywa maji kutoka kwenye bomba.

translations.source: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.reference: Kulingana na shirika la nyuklia la Japan, mionzi, cesiamu na iodini zimetambuliwa kiwandani.
translations.hypothesis: Kulingana na taasisi ya Japan kuhusu jadili, mada ya cesium na iodine yenye radioactivity imetambuliwa katika kiwanda hicho.

translations.source: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.reference: Serikali inabashiri kuwa hii inaonyesha kuwa vyombo vinayokuwa na Urani kwenye tovuti vinaweza kuwa vimetoboka na vinavuja.
translations.hypothesis: Vituo vya mamlaka wanaona kuwa hii inaonyesha kwamba vyombo ambavyo vimewekwa urani, ambavyo vimewekwa katika eneo hilo, vinaweza kuwa vimeharibika na vinaweza kuwa vinaivuja.

translations.source: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.reference: Dk. Tony Moll aligundua Kifua Kikuu Kinachokinza Dawa Kabisa (XDR-TB) katika eneo la KwaZulu-Natal, Afrika Kusini.
translations.hypothesis: Dato Tony Moll aligundua magonjwa ya kuvimbi yenye ulemavu wa tiba (XDR-TB) katika eneo la Kusini mwa Afrika, KwaZulu-Natal.

translations.source: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.reference: Katika mahojiano, alisema aina mpya ilikuwa "ya kusumbua sana na ya kutisha kwa sababu ya kiwango cha juu cha kufariki."
translations.hypothesis: Katika mahojari, alisema kwamba aina mpya hiyo ni "ya hatari sana na ya kutisha, kwa sababu ina kiwango cha juu cha vifo."

translations.source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.reference: Huenda baadhi ya wagonjwa waliambukizwa mdudu huyo hospitalini, kama anavyofikiria Dkt. Moll, na angalau wawili walikuwa wafanyakazi hospitalini.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya wagonjwa wanaweza kuwa wameugua ugonjwa katika hospitali, kimsingi, Dr. Moll anadhani, na angalau wawili walikuwa ni wafanyakazi wa hospitali.

translations.source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.reference: Katika mwaka mmoja, mtu aliyeambukizwa huenda akaambukiza wato 10-15 wa karibu.
translations.hypothesis: Katika mwaka mmoja, mtu ambaye ameuambukizwa anaweza kuambukiza watu 10 hadi 15 karibu.

translations.source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, asilimia ya XDR-TB katika kikundi kizima cha watu wenye kifua kikuu bado inaonekana kuwa chini, watu 6,000 kati ya 330,000 walioambukizwa kwa wakati wowote maalumu katika Afrika Kusini.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, asilimia ya magonjwa ya XDR-TB katika makundi yote wa watu wenye magonjwa ya TB bado inaonekana kuwa ndogo; 6,000 kati ya idadi ya 330,000 watu walioathiriwa katika Afrika Kusini katika wakati fulani.

translations.source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.reference: Setilaiti, ambazo zote mbili zilikuwa na uzani wa zaidi ya pauni 1,000, na kusafiri kwa takribani maili 17,500 kwa saa, ziligongana maili 491 juu ya Dunia.
translations.hypothesis: Vyanzo, ambavyo vilikuwa vyote na uzito wa zaidi ya 1,000 paun, na vilivyoendesha kwa kasi ya takriban 17,500 maili kwa saa, vilivyoana 491 maili juu ya ardhi.

translations.source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.reference: Wanasayansi wanasema mlipuko uliosababishwa na mgongano huo ulikuwa mkubwa.
translations.hypothesis: Wataalamu wanasema kwamba mlipuko uliojazwa na mlio, ulikuwa kubwa.

translations.source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.reference: Bado wanajaribu kuamua kiwango cha ukubwa cha mgongano na jinsi Ulimwengu utaathirika.
translations.hypothesis: Wao bado wanajaribu kuamua ni kiasi gani tukio hilo lilitokea na jinsi dunia itatathminiwa.

translations.source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.reference: Amri ya Kimkakati ya Marekani ya ofisi ya Idara ya Ulinzi ya Marekani inafuatilia vifusi.
translations.hypothesis: Ofisi ya Uaguzi wa Kimkakati wa Marekani, ambayo ni sehemu ya Wizara ya Ulinzi ya Marekani, inafuatilia vumbi.

translations.source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.reference: Matokeo ya uchambuzi wa uchoraji yatatumwa kwenye tovuti ya umma.
translations.hypothesis: Matokeo ya uchambuzi wa data itapostwa kwenye tovuti ya umma.

translations.source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.reference: Daktari aliyefanya kazi katika Hospitali ya Watoto ya Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania atashtakiwa kwa uuaji uliochochewa baada ya mamake kupatikana ameuawa katika buti ya gari lake Jumatano, mamlaka ya Ohio inasema.
translations.hypothesis: Daktari ambaye alifanya kazi katika Hospitali ya Watoto ya Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, atachukuliwa hatia ya mauaji ya haraka baada ya mama yake kupatikana aliyekufa ndani ya gari yake, kulingana na vyombo vya mamlaka katika Ohio.

translations.source: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.

translations.hypothesis: Dato Malar Balasubramanian, mwenye umri wa miaka 29, aligunduliwa katika Blue Ash, Ohio, eneo la peri linalojumwa kilomita 15 kaskazini mwa Cincinnati, alikuwa amelang'aa translations.source: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.reference: Aliwaelekeza maafisa kwenye Oldsmobile yake nyeusi ambayo ilikiwa kwa umbali wa futi 500.
translations.hypothesis: Alituma maafisa kwenda kwenye gari lake la Oldsmobile Intrigue, ambalo lilikuwa umbali wa futo 500.

translations.source: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.reference: Hapo, walipata mwili wa Saroja Balasubramanian, aliyekuwa na umri wa miaka 53, umefunikwa kwa blanketi zilizokuwa na madoa ya damu.
translations.hypothesis: Hapo, walipata mwili wa Saroja Balasubramanian, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, uliokuwa uliongozwa na kofia zilizotea damu.

translations.source: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.reference: Polisi walisema kwamba ilionekana kama mwili huo ulikuwa hapo kwa takriban siku moja.
translations.hypothesis: Polisi wamesema kwamba mwili huo alionekana kuwa huko kwa takribu siku moja.

translations.source: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.reference: Kesi za kwanza za ugonjwa huo msimu huu ziliripotiwa mwishoni mwa Julai.
translations.hypothesis: Kesi za kwanza za ugonjwa katika msimu huu ziliwasilishwa mwishoni mwa Julai.

translations.source: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.reference: Ugonjwa huo hubebwa na nguruwe, kisha huhamia kwa binadamu kupitia mbu.
translations.hypothesis: Ugonjwa huu unaenezwa na nyama, ambazo kisha huenea kwa wanadamu kupitia nyoka.

translations.source: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.reference: Mkurupuko huo umechochea serikali ya India kuchukua hatua kama kuwatuma wawinda nguruwe katika maeneo yaliyoathiriwa sana, na kusambaza maelfu ya mapazia ya mbu na kunyunyiza dawa za kuua wadudu.
translations.hypothesis: Tishogo limepelekea serikali ya India kuchukua hatua kama vile kuajiri maafisa wa uhifadhi, kuwasambaza maumbo ya kupunguza mende kwa wingi, na kupanda dawa za kupunguza mende.

translations.source: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.reference: Vichupa milioni kadhaa vya chanjo ya uvimbe wa ubongo vimeahidiwa na serikali, ambavyo vitasaidia kuandaa mawakala wa afya kwa mwaka ujao.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, serikali imetoa ahadi ya milions ya virutubishi za chanjo ya encephalitis, ambazo zitasaidia taasisi za afya kupanga kwa mwaka ujao.

translations.source: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
translations.reference: Mipango ya kufikisha chanjo mwaka huu katika maeneo yanayojulikana kihistoria kuathirika sana ilicheleweshwa kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa fedha na kipaumbele cha chini ikilinganishwa na magonjwa mengine.
translations.hypothesis: Mpango wa kuendeleza chanjo kwa maeneo ambayo vimeathirika sana katika historia, mwaka huu, ulileta, kutokana na ukosefu wa fedha na umuhimu mdogo ikilinganishwa na magonjwa mengine.

translations.source: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.reference: Mnamo 1956 Slania alihamia Uswidi, ambako miaka mitatu baadaye alianza kazi katika Ofisi ya Posta ya Uswidi na akawa mchoraji wao mkuu.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo mwaka wa 1956, Słania alihamia Sweden, ambapo baada ya miaka mitatu, alianza kufanya kazi katika ofisi ya posta ya Sweden na kuwa mshiriki mkuu wa ufundishaji.

translations.source: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
translations.reference: Alizalisha stempu zaidi ya 1,000 kwa Uswidi na nchi nyingine 28.
translations.hypothesis: Alitengeneza zaidi ya 1,000 aina za postapeli kwa Sweden na 28 mataifa mengine.

translations.source: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
translations.reference: Kazi yake ni ya ubora na undani wa kutambulika sana hadi yeye ni mmoja wa wachache katika “majina ya kinyumbani” kati ya wanastempu. Watu wengine hushughulika na kuikusanya kazi yake pekee.
translations.hypothesis: Kazi yake ni ya ubora na undani ambao ni maarufu, na kwa hiyo, yeye ni mmoja wa watu wachache "mashujaa" katika jamii ya wapenzi wa posta. Baadhi wao wanaspecializa katika kukusanya kazi zake pekee.

translations.source: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
translations.reference: Stempu yake ya 1,000 ilikuwa “Great Deeds by Swedish Kings” nzuri sana na David Klocker Ehrenstrahl mwaka wa 2000, ambayo imetajwa katika Guinness Book of World Records..
translations.hypothesis: Alipata alama yake ya 1,000, ilikuwa alama nzuri "Matendo Mazuri ya Watawala wa Usweden" ya David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl, iliyotayarishwa mwaka 2000, ambayo inaorodheshwa katika Kitabu cha Rekodi za Dunia cha Guinness.

translations.source: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
translations.reference: Pia alikuwa anashughulika na uchoraji wa noti za benki kwa nchi nyingi, mifano ya hivi karibuni ya kazi yake ikiwa ni pamoja na picha za Uwaziri Mkuu katika upande wa mbele wa noti mpya za dola 5 na dola 100 za Kanada.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, alihusika katika uundaji wa benki za fedha kwa nchi nyingi, na mifano ya hivi karibuni ya kazi yake ni picha za wajumbe wa rais kwenye upande wa benki za fedha mpya za Kanada, za $5 na $100.

translations.source: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
translations.reference: Baada ya ajali kutokea, Gibson alisafirishwa hospitalini lakini alifariki muda mfupi baadaye.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya tukio hilo, Gibson alitolewa hospitalini, lakini alifariki baada ya muda.

translations.source: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
translations.reference: Dereva wa lori, aliye na umri wa miaka 64, hakujeruhiwa katika ajali.
translations.hypothesis: Dereva wa lori, ambaye ni mwenye umri wa miaka 64, hakuwa na majeraha katika ajali hiyo.

translations.source: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
translations.reference: Gari lenyewe liliondolewa kwenye eneo la ajali takriban saa 1200 GMT siku hiyo hiyo.
translations.hypothesis: Gari hilo lilitolewa kutoka eneo la ajali kuanzia saa 12:00 mchana, katika siku hiyo.

translations.source: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
translations.reference: Mtu aliyekuwa akifanya kazi karibu na gereji iliyo karibu na eneo la ajali hiyo alisema: "Kulikuwa na watoto waliokuwa wakisubiri kuvuka barabara na wote walikuwa wakipiga mayowe na kulia."
translations.hypothesis: Mtu aliyefanya kazi katika gari karibu na eneo ambapo tukio lilitokea alisema: "Kuna watoto walikuwa wategemea kupita barabara, na wote walikuwa wakiuliza na kuomboleza."

translations.source: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
translations.reference: Wote walikimbia kutoka kwenye mahali ambapo ajali ilikuwa imetokea.
translations.hypothesis: Wote walarudi kutoka eneo ambapo tukio hilo liliendelea.

translations.source: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
translations.reference: Masomo mengine kwenye agenda kule Bali yanahusu kunusuru misitu ya dunia iliyobaki, na kuzisambaza teknolojia za kusaidia nchi zinazoendelea kukua kwa njia zisizo na uchafuzi mkubwa.
translations.hypothesis: Mada zingine kwenye agenda katika Bali ni pamoja na kuokoa misitu iliyobaki duniani, na kushiriki teknolojia ili kusaidia jamii zinazopanda kuendeleza kwa njia zisizo na uchafuzi.

translations.source: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.reference: Umoja wa Mataifa pia una matumaini ya kumaliza ufadhili wa kusaidia mataifa yaliyoathirika kutokana na ongezeko la joto duniani ili kuweza kupambana na athari.
translations.hypothesis: Umoja wa Mataifa pia anatarajia kumalizia mfumo wa fedha ili kusaidia nchi zinazosumbuliwa na upungaji wa hali ya hewa, ili waweze kukabiliana na madhara.

translations.source: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.reference: Pesa zingeenda kwa nyumba ambazo ni sugu-kwa-mafurikowa, usimamizi bora wa maji, na mseto wa mazao.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, fedha hizo zinaweza kutumika katika ujenzi wa nyumba zenye ulinzi dhidi ya matetemeko, usimamizi bora wa maji, na mbinu za kilimo mbalimbali.

translations.source: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.reference: Fluke aliandika kwamba juhudi za baadhi kuzamisha wanawake wasizungumze kuhusu uzima wa wanawake hazikufaulu.
translations.hypothesis: Fluke aliandika kwamba juhudi za baadhi za kuzuia wanawake kutoka kuzungumzia masuala ya afya ya wanawake, hazikuufikia malengo yao.

translations.source: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
translations.reference: Alifikia hitimisho hili kutokana na wingi wa maoni chanya na kutiwa moyo kwake na wake kwa waume waliohimiza kuwa matibabu ya uzazi yachukuliwe kuwa mahitaji muhimu ya kimatibabu.
translations.hypothesis: Alifikia kuwa na hitimisho hili kutokana na maoni mengi na ushauri pozyatifu ambazo alipokea kutoka kwa wanawake na wanaume, ambapo walitaka kwamba dawa za mwanamke iwe ni muhimu kwa ajili ya matibabu.

translations.source: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
translations.reference: Wakati mapigano yalipokoma na majeruhi kupelekwa hospitalini, takriban 40 wa wafungwa waliobaki walikaa kwenye yadi na kukataa kurudi kwenye seli zao.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya vita kuishia na wagonjwa kupelekezwa hospitalini, kuhusu 40 kutoka kwa wengine waliokuwa ndani, walibaki katika eneo la nje na kulipu kuhusu kurudi kwenye vyoo zao.

translations.source: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
translations.reference: Wapatanishi walijaribu kurekebisha hali, lakini mahitaji ya wafungwa si dhahiri.
translations.hypothesis: Wawakilishi walijaribu kurekebisha hali, lakini mahitaji ya wafangwa si wazi.

translations.source: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
translations.reference: Kati ya saa 4 na 5 usiku MDT, moto uliwashwa kwenye yadi na wafungwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa muda wa kati ya saa 10:00 na 11:00 mchana, alama ilianzishwa na wafungwa katika eneo la bustani.

translations.source: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
translations.reference: Karibuni, maafisa walio na vyombo vya ghasia waliingia kwenye yadi na kuwazingira wafungwa kwa vitoa machozi.
translations.hypothesis: Hivi, maafisa walio na vifaa vya kupigana, walingojea eneo na kuwafunga wahi, kwa kutumia gesi ya kupiga.

translations.source: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
translations.reference: Kundi la uokoaji wa moto hatimaye walizima moto huo saa 11:35 usiku.
translations.hypothesis: Wahudumu wa majeraha hatimaye walizima moto saa 11:35 usiku.

translations.source: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
translations.reference: Baada ya bwawa kujengwa mwaka wa 1963, mafuriko ya msimu ambayo yangeenea kote yalisimamishwa.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya ujenzi wa mto mwaka wa 1963, maji ya maji ya msimu ambayo kawaida hufanya mto ugeuzwe, yalikoma.

translations.source: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
translations.reference: Mashapo yalikuwa muhimu kwa kuunda mafungu ya mchanga na pwani, ambazo zilitumika kama makao ya wanyamapori.
translations.hypothesis: Hii malisho ilikuwa muhimu kwa uundaji wa mada na mashambani, ambazo zilikuwa nyenzo muhimu kwa wanyama.

translations.source: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
translations.reference: Kama matokeo, spishi mbili za samaki zimetoweka, na nyingine mbili zimekuwa katika hatari, zikiwemo humpback chub.
translations.hypothesis: Matokeo yake, aina mbili za samaki zimepotea, na aina nyingine mbili zimekuwa katika hatari, ikiwa ni pamoja na samaki aina ya "humpback chub".

translations.source: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
translations.reference: Ingawa kiwango cha maji kitaongezeka kwa futi chache tu baada ya mafuriko, maafisa wanatumai kwamba kitatosha kurejesha mafungu ya mchanga yaliyomomonyolewa katika sehemu ya chini ya mto.
translations.hypothesis: Licha ya kwamba kiwanda kitozwa kwa umbali wa futi chache baada ya mafuriko, viongozi wanatumai kuwa ni ya kutosha kuleta upya mada za mchanga ambazo zimepotea chini.

translations.source: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
translations.reference: Hakuna ilani ya tsunami iliyotolewa, na kulingana na uwakala wa jeofizikia wa Jakarta, hakuna ilani ya tsunami itakayotolewa kwani mtetemeko haukufikia ukubwa unaohitajika wa 6.5.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuna tangazo la dhoruba, na kulingana na idara ya geofizikia ya Jakarta, hakuna tangazo la dhoruba la toke, kwa sababu earthquake hiyo haikopima ukubwa wa 6.5.

translations.source: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
translations.reference: Licha ya kutokuwa na tishio la tsunami, wakazi walianza kuwa na hofu na wakaanza kuacha biashara na nyumba zao.
translations.hypothesis: Licha ya kwamba hakuna hatari ya tsunami, wakazi walianza kuwa na wasiwasi na kuanza kuondoka kutoka kwa biashara zao na nyumba zao.

translations.source: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
translations.reference: Ingawa Winfrey alitokwa na machozi wakati wa kuagana kwake, aliwaambia mashabiki wake dhahiri kwamba angerudi tena.
translations.hypothesis: Licha ya kuwa mwenye huzuni wakati wa kuondoka, Winfrey alitaka kuwa watoaji, kwamba atarudi.

translations.source: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
translations.reference: “Hii haitakuwa kwaheri. Huku ni kufungwa kwa sura moja na kufunguliwa kwa nyingine.”
translations.hypothesis: "Hii si kwa maana kwamba tumemaliza. Hii ni mwisho wa sura moja na mwisho wa sura mpya."

translations.source: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
translations.reference: Matokeo ya mwisho ya uchaguzi wa rais na wabunge wa Namibia yameonyesha kwamba rais aliye mamlakani, Hifikepunye Pohamba, amechaguliwa tena kwa kiasi kikubwa.
translations.hypothesis: Matokeo ya mwisho katika uchaguzi wa rais na bunge wa Namibia zinaonyesha kwamba rais wa sasa, Hifikepunye Pohamba, amechaguliwa tena kwa kura nyingi.

translations.source: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
translations.reference: Chama Tawala, Jumuiya ya Watu wa Kusini Magharibi mwa Afrika (SWAPO), pia kilihifadhi viti vingi katika chaguzi za bunge.
translations.hypothesis: Chama cha serikali, Chama cha Watu wa Afrika Kusini Magharibi (SWAPO), pia kilopata ushindi katika uchaguzi wa bunge.

translations.source: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
translations.reference: Muungano na vikosi vya Afghani vilihamia eneo hilo ili kulisalimisha pamoja na ndege nyingine za muungano zimetumwa ili kusaidia.
translations.hypothesis: Timu za pamoja na askari wa Afghanistan zimetua katika eneo hilo ili kulinda eneo hilo na, na pia, ndege zingine za pamoja zimeutumwa ili kutoa msaada.

translations.source: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
translations.reference: Kishindo hicho kilitokea juu zaidi kwenye milima, na inaaminika kilikuwa matokeo ya shambulizi la adui.
translations.hypothesis: Tukio hilo lilitokea katika eneo la mlima, na inadhaniwa kuwa lilituzwa na risasi za adui.

translations.source: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
translations.reference: Juhudi za kutafuta eneo la ajali zinapingwa na hali mbaya ya hewa na maeneo yenye mazingara magumu.
translations.hypothesis: Jihad za kutafuta eneo ambapo ajali ilitokea zimepata vizuizi kutokana na hali mbaya ya hewa na mandhari ngumu.

translations.source: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
translations.reference: Msaada wa matibabu Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres na Shirika la Afya Duniani wanasema ni mlipuko mbaya zaidi uliorekodiwa nchini.
translations.hypothesis: Kituo cha matibabu la Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres, na Shirika la Afya cha Dunia zinaonya kuwa hii ni janga mbaya zaidi lililotokea nchini.

translations.source: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
translations.reference: Msemaji wa Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman alisema: “Angola inaelekea kwenye mkurupuko mbaya zaidi daima na hali inabaki kuwa mbaya sana katika Angola,” alisema.
translations.hypothesis: Msemaji wa Shirika la "Médecins Sans Frontières", Richard Veerman, alisema: "Angola ina hatari ya janga mbaya zaidi, na hali katika Angola bado ni mbaya sana," amesema.

translations.source: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
translations.reference: Michezo hiyo ilianza saa 10 asubuhi na hali nzuri ya hewa na ingawaje kulikuwa na manyunyu ya katikati ya asubuhi ambayo yaliisha haraka, ilikuwa siku nzuri kwa raga ya watu 7.
translations.hypothesis: Michezo ilianza saa 10:00 asubuhi na hali ya hewa ilikuwa nzuri. Pamoja na mvua kidogo saa 10:00, ambayo ilipita haraka, ilikuwa siku bora kwa mchezo wa rugby wa 7.

translations.source: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
translations.reference: Wachezaji wa juu katika mashindano, Afrika Kusini, walianza vizuri walipowashinda Zambia walio katika nafasi ya 5 kwa 26 - 00 kwa urahisi.
translations.hypothesis: Klabu bora za mashindano, South Africa, ziliianza kwa ushindi wa 26-00 dhidi ya Zambia, ambayo ilikuwa nafasi ya tano.

translations.source: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
translations.reference: Wakionekana hakika kudhoofika katika mchezo dhidi ya dada zao wa kusini, Afrika Kusini hata hivyo walitia fora jinsi mashindano yalivyoendelea.
translations.hypothesis: Katika mechi dhidi wa timu zao kutoka kusini, timu ya Afrika Kusini ilionekana kuwa chini, lakini waliboresha hatua kwa hatua wakati mashindano zilikuwa zikiendelea.

translations.source: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
translations.reference: Ulinzi wao wa nidhamu, ustadi wa kushughulikia mpira, na kazi bora ya pamoja ziliwafanya wajitokeze na ikawa wazi kuwa hii ndiyo iliyokuwa timu ya kushinda.
translations.hypothesis: Стратеjia yao ya kujilinda, ujuzi wa kudhibiti mpira, na shughuli nzuri za timu, ziliwafanya kuwa tofauti, na ilikuwa wazi kwamba hii ilikuwa timu ambayo inaweza kushinda.

translations.source: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
translations.reference: Maafisa wa mji wa Amsterdam na Makavazi ya Anne Frank wanasema kwamba mti huo umeambukizwa kuvu na unatoa hatari kwa afya ya jamii kwani walisema kwamba ulikuwa katika hatari ya karibu ya kuanguka.
translations.hypothesis: Wajumbe kutoka jiji la Amsterdam na Muzeum la Anne Frank wamesema kwamba mti huo umeambukizwa na kundi la mimea, na hatua hiyo inazua hatari kwa afya ya umma, kwani wanasema kwamba mti huo alikuwa katika hatari kubwa ya kupasuka.

translations.source: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.reference: Ulikuwa umeratibiwa kukatwa mnamo Jumanne, lakini uliokolewa na uamuzi wa dharura wa korti.
translations.hypothesis: Ilikuwa imepangwa kukatwa siku ya Jumatana, lakini ilikomo baada ya uamuzi wa haraka wa mahakama.

translations.source: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.reference: Milango yote ya pango, iliyopewa jina "Dada Saba", ina kipenyo cha angalau mita 100 hadi 250 (futi 328 hadi 820).
translations.hypothesis: Mifingilio yote, ambazo viliitwa "Biblia Saba", zina ukubwa wa angalau 100 hadi 250 मिटर (328 hadi 820 фуट्स).

translations.source: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.reference: Picha za miale isiyoonekana zinaonyesha kwamba utofauti wa joto kati ya usiku na mchana unaonyesha kwamba huenda ni mapango.
translations.hypothesis: Picha za infra-red zinaonyesha kwamba mabadiliko ya joto kati ya usiku na mchana zinaonyesha kuwa ni misitu.

translations.source: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.reference: "Ni baridi kuliko maeneo ya karibu katika mchana na ni ya joto zaidi katika usiku.
translations.hypothesis: "Zimekaa vizuri kuliko eneo lenye majirani wakati wa mchana, na kuwa moto wakati wa usiku.

translations.source: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: Tabia yazo ya kijoto si thabiti kama mapango makubwa katika Dunia ambayo mara nyingi hudumisha halijoto sawa kwa kadiri fulani, lakini inapatana nazo kuwa mashimo marefu ardhini," alisema Glen Cushing wa Timu ya Falakiolojia ya Utafiti wa Jiolojia wa Marekani (USGS) na wa Chuo Kikuu cha Arizona Kaskazini kilichoko Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.hypothesis: Tabia yao ya joto si sawa kama kwenye kina kwenye ardhi ambapo mara nyingi zina joto sawa, lakini ni sawa na hizi kuwa ni kina kwenye ardhi," alisema Glen Cushing kutoka Timu ya Uzalishaji wa Angalia ya Marekani (USGS) na Chuo Kikuu cha Arizona Mashariki, lililopo katika Flagstaff, Arizona.

translations.source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
