translations.reference: Huko Ufaransa, upigaji kura tangu jadi umekuwa uzoefu wa teknolojia ambayo haijaimarika: wapigaji kura hujitenga kwenye kibanda, kisha wanaweka karatasi iliyochapishwa mapema kuonyesha mgombea wao wa uchaguzi katika bahasha.
translations.hypothesis: Katika Ufaransa, kupiga kura kwa kawaida ni uzoefu wa aina ya msingi: wapiga kura hushikilia katika chumba, na wachanua karatasi iliyoandikwa tayari, ambayo inaonyesha mwaniaji wao, na kuichanganya kwenye봉투.

translations.source: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.reference: Baada ya maafisa kuthibitisha utambulisho wa mpigaji kura, mpigaji kura hutumbukiza bahasha kwenye sanduku la kura na kusaini orodha ya kupiga kura.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya maafasi kuathiri utambulisho wa mshiriki, mshiriki hupiga eneo kwenye sanduku la kura na pia husaini orodha ya wachezaji.

translations.source: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.reference: Sheria ya uchaguzi ya Ufaransa badala yake hupanga kesi hiyo kwenye msimbo. Madhubuti.
translations.hypothesis: Sheria ya uchaguzi ya Ufaransa inatoa maelekezo vyema kuhusu mchakato.

translations.source: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.reference: Tangu 1988, ni lazima masanduku ya kura yawe maangavu ili wapigaji kura na wachunguzi waweze kushuhudia kwamba hakuna bahasha zinazoongezwa isipokuwa zile za wapigaji kura waliohesabiwa na kuidhinishwa.
translations.hypothesis: Tangu 1988, sanduku za kupigia kura lazima ziwe wazi ili wapiga kura na watafiti waweze kuona kwamba hakuna sanduku za kufunika kwenye mwisho wa kupigia kura, na kwamba hakuna sanduku za ziada ambazo zimeongezwa isipokuwa hizo za wapiga kura waliopigia kura na waliruhusiwa.

translations.source: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.reference: Wagombeaji wanaweza kutuma wawakilishi kushuhudia kila sehemu ya mchakato. Jioni, kura huhesabiwa na watu waliojitolea chini ya usimamizi mkubwa, kwa kufuata utaratibu maalum.
translations.hypothesis: Watumaji wanaweza kutuma wakala waweze kuona kila hatua ya mchakato. Mnamo usiku, upigaji kura unafanyika na watoa, chini ya usimamizi mkubwa, kwa kuzingatia taratibu maalum.

translations.source: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.reference: Tarakilishi ya ASUS Eee, iliyozinduliwa mapema dunia nzima kwa sababu za uokoaji fedha na utendaji, ikawa mada moto mnamo 2007 Mwezi wa Teknolojia na Mawasiliano wa Taipei.
translations.hypothesis: ASUS Eee PC, ambayo ilianzishwa kwa ufanisi na utendaji, ilikuwa mada muhimu katika Mwezi wa Teknolojia wa Taipei mwaka wa 2007.

translations.source: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.reference: Lakini soko la watumiaji wa kompyuta ndogo litatofautiana na kubadilika sana baada ya ASUS kuzawadiwa tuzo la 2007 la Tuzo Endelevu la Taiwan na Mtendaji Yuan wa Jamhuri ya China.
translations.hypothesis: Lakini, soko la vifaa vya kompyuta za laptop itabadilika sana baada ya kampuni ya ASUS kupokea Tuzo ya Usalama ya Taiwan mwaka wa 2007, ambayo ilitolewa na Baraza la Katibuni la Jamhuri ya China.

translations.source: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.reference: Wavuti wa kituo hicho unaelezea onyesho hilo kama "Thieta ya zamani ya redio yenye mzunguko mpya wa kukera na wa kichizi!"
translations.hypothesis: Tovuti ya stesheni inaeleza programu kama "theatru la redio la zamani, na yenye mwelekeo mpya na wa kipekee!"

translations.source: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.reference: Katika siku zake za mwanzo mwanzo, onyesho hilo liliwasilishwa tu kwenye wavuti ya muda mrefu ya redio ya intaneti ya TogiNet, wavuti iliyozingatia mazungumzo ya redioni.
translations.hypothesis: Katika hatua za awali, programu hiyo ilikuwa inatumika tu kwenye tovuti ya redio ya mtandaoni inayojulikana kama TogiNet Radio, tovuti ambayo iloanisha redio ya mazungumzo.

translations.source: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.reference: Mwishoni mwa 2015, TogiNet ilianzisha Redio ya AstroNet kama idhaa tanzu.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo mwisho wa 2015, TogiNet ilianzisha AstroNet Radio kama kituo cha kwingine.

translations.source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.reference: Kipindi cha awali kilionyesha waigizaji wa sauti wasio na ujuzi, wa ndani hadi Mashariki mwa Texas.
translations.hypothesis: Kazi hiyo ilianza kwa watoaji sauti ambao hawakuwa wataalamu, na walikuwa kutoka eneo la Mashariki la Texas.

translations.source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.reference: Inasemekana uporaji ulioenea uliendelea usiku kucha, kwani maafisa wa utekelezaji wa sheria hawakuwako katika mitaa ya Bishkek.
translations.hypothesis: Uharamu wa bidhaa, kulingana na taarifa, ulirudi, licha ya kwamba maafisa wa sheria hakukuwepo kwenye mitaa ya Bishkek.

translations.source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.reference: Bishkek ilielezewa kama iliyozama katika hali ya "mchafuko" na mtazamaji mmoja, huku magenge ya watu wakirandaranda mitaani na kupora maduka ya bidhaa za watumiaji.
translations.hypothesis: Bishkek ilieleweka kuwa imepata hali ya "usimamizi", ambapo vikundi vya watu walitoka katika mitaa na kuchukua bidhaa za kawaida kutoka kwenye maduka.

translations.source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.reference: Wakaaji kadhaa wa Bishkek waliwalaumu waandamanaji kutoka kusini kwa uvunjaji huo wa sheria.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wengi waliokuwa katika mji wa Bishkek waliwashutumu waandishi wa maandishi kutoka kaskazini kwa uhalifu.

translations.source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.reference: Afrika Kusini wamewashinda All Blacks (Nyuzilandi) katika mechi ya muungano wa raga ya Mataifa Matatu katika Uwanja wa Royal Bafokeng katika Rustenburg, Afrika Kusini.
translations.hypothesis: Timu ya Afrika Kusini imewashinda timu ya All Blacks (Uru New Zealand) katika mechi ya Tri Nations katika uwanja wa Royal Bafokeng huko Rustenburg, Afrika Kusini.

translations.source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.reference: Alama ya mwisho ilikuwa ushindi wa nukta moja, 21 hadi 20, na kumaliza mfuo wa ushindi wa michezo wa Weusi Wote.
translations.hypothesis: النتيجة النهائية ilikuwa ushindi wa pointi moja, 21 kwa 20, ambapo timu ya All Blacks ilipoteza rekodi yao ya ushindi wa mechi 15.

translations.source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.reference: Kwa Springboksi, iliishia kuwa mfuo wa kupoteza mechi-tano
translations.hypothesis: Kwa timu ya Springboks, hii ilikuwa mwisho wa mfululizo wa matokeo sita za hasara.

translations.source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.reference: Ilikuwa mechi ya mwisho kwa All Blacks, ambao tayari walikuwa wameshinda kombe wiki mbili zilizopita.
translations.hypothesis: Hii ilikuwa mechi ya mwisho kwa timu ya All Blacks, ambazo zimepata cheo hivi majuzi.

translations.source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.reference: Mechi ya mwisho ya msururu itafanyika katika Ellis Park mjini Johannesburg wiki ijayo, wakati Springboks watakapocheza dhidi ya Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Mechi ya mwisho ya mzunguko itafanyika katika uwanja wa Ellis Park huko Johannesburg wiki ijayo, ambapo timu ya Springboks itacheza na Australia.

translations.source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.reference: Mtetemeko wastani wa ardhi ulitikisa Montana magharibi saa 4 na dakika 8 usiku wa Jumatatu.
translations.hypothesis: Ghafla, earthquake hafifu ilisukumana katika kaskazini mwa Montana, saa 20:08 mnamo Jumatano.

translations.source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.reference: Hakuna ripoti za sasa zilizopokewa na Utafiti wa Jiolojia wa Marekani (USGS) na Kituo chake cha Kitaifa cha Taarifa za Mitetemeko ya Ardhi.
translations.hypothesis: Hata sasa, Wizara ya Sayansi ya Marekani (USGS) na Kituo lake cha Habari za Majaribio, haijapokea taarifa za uharibifu.

translations.source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.reference: Kitovu cha mtetemeko huo kilikuwa takriban kilomita 20 (maili 15) kaskazini mwa kaskazini mashariki mwa Dillon, na takriban kilomita 65 (maili 40) kusini mwa Butte.
translations.hypothesis: Голго, ارتداد huo ulikuwa katikati takribani kilomita 20 (mialem 15) kaskazini-kaskarini kutoka Dillon, na takribani kilomita 65 (mialem 40) kusini kutoka Butte.

translations.source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.reference: Aina ya homa ya ndege iliyo hatari kwa binadamu, H5N1, imethibitishwa kuambukiza bata mwitu aliyekufa, aliyepatikana Jumatatu, katika kinamasi karibu na Lyon mashariki mwa Ufaransa.
translations.hypothesis: Virusi vya aina ya 'H5N1', ambavyo ni hatari kwa binadamu, ambavyo vimekuwa na athari, vimeathiri ng'ombe, ambazo zilitumbuliwa siku ya maandishi, katika eneo la maji la karibu na Lyon, kaskazini mwa Ufaransa.

translations.source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.reference: Ufaransa ni nchi ya saba katika Jumuiya ya Ulaya kukabiliwa na virusi hivi; kufuatia Austria, Ujerumani, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Ugiriki na Italia.
translations.hypothesis: Ufaransa ni nchi ya saba katika Umoja wa Europa ambayo imepata virusi hili; kufuatia Austria, Ujerumani, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece na Italia.

translations.source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.reference: Matukio yanayoshukiwa ya H5N1 katika Kroatia na Denmaki hayajathibitishwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kes esetapo za H5N1 nchini Kroasia na Denmark bado hazijathibitishwa.

translations.source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.reference: Ghambers alikuwa amemshtaki Mungu kwa "vifo, uharibifu na ugaidi uilioenea, wa mamilioni ya mamilioni ya wakaazi wa Dunia."
translations.hypothesis: Chambers alewalenga Mungu kwa "ufa, uharibifu, na kutawana kwa wingi kwa mamilioni ya wakazi wa dunia."

translations.source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.reference: Chambers, anayeamini kuwa kuwepo kwa Mungu hakujulikani, anasema kuwa kesi yake ni ya “kijinga” na “mtu yeyote anaweza kumshtaki yeyote.”
translations.hypothesis: Chambers, ambaye ni mtu isiyowadhani, anasema kwamba kesi yake ni "isiyo na msingi" na "yeyote anaweza kuidai yeyote."

translations.source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.reference: Hadithi iliyotolewa kwenye mchezo wa kifaransa wa kuigiza wa opera na Camille Saint-Saens ni wa msanii “ambaye maisha yake yanaamuriwa na upendo wa madawa na Japani.
translations.hypothesis: Hadithi iliyotolewa katika opera ya Kifaransa, iliyoandikwa na Camille Saint-Saens, ni kuhusu mwanamuziki "ambaye maisha yake yanaendesha kwa mapenzi ya dawa na Japani."

translations.source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.reference: Kama matokeo, watendaji huvuta misokoto ya bangi kwenye jukwaa, na ukumbi wenyewe unawahimiza hadhira kushiriki.
translations.hypothesis: Matokeo yake, wageni wanachuma dawa za kannabis kwenye ukumbi, na ukumbi huo pia unaendelea kuwahamasisha wadau.

translations.source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.reference: Spika wa awali Newt Gingrich, gavana wa Texas Rick Perry na Mbunge Michelle Bachmann walimaliza katika nafasi za nne, tano, na sita mtawalia.
translations.hypothesis: Msemaji wa Bunge, Newt Gingrich, gavani wa Texas, Rick Perry, na Kongreswa, Michele Bachmann, walishinda nafasi ya nne, tano, na sita, kwa mtiririko huo.

translations.source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.reference: Baada ya matokeo kuingia, Gingrich alimpongeza Santorum, lakini alikuwa na maneno makali kwa Romney, ambaye matangazo hasi ya kampeni yalipeperushwa kwa niaba yake dhidi ya Gingrich.
translations.hypothesis: Baada ya matokeo kuwasilishwa, Gingrich aliamua kutoa sifa kwa Santorum, lakini alikuwa na maneno magumu kwa Romney, ambaye kampeni yake ilikuwa na matangazo hasi katika Iowa dhidi ya Gingrich.

translations.source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.reference: Perry alisema, "Nitarudi Texas ili kutathmini matokeo ya mkutano wa usiku wa leo, kuamua kama kuna njia yangu ya kusonga mbele katika mbio hizi", lakini baadaye akasema kwamba angebaki kwenye mbio na kushindana katika uchaguzi wa msingi wa Carolina Kusini mnamo Januari 21.
translations.hypothesis: Perry alisema kwamba "atafanya safari kwenda Texas ili kukagua matokeo ya mikutano leo, na pia kutathmini ikiwa kuna njia ya kwenda mbele kwangu katika kampeni hii", lakini baadaye alisema kwamba atabaki katika kampeni na kushiriki katika uchaguzi wa Januari 21 katika jimbo la South Carolina.

translations.source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.reference: Bachmann, aliyeshinda Kura ya maoni ya Ames Straw mnamo Agosti, aliamua kukomesha kampeni yake.
translations.hypothesis: Bachmann, ambaye alishinda kilele cha Ames mnamo Agosti, aliamua kuacha kampeni yake.

translations.source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.reference: Mpigaji picha alichukuliwa hadi Kituo cha Matibabu cha Ronald Reagan, ambako baadaye alifariki.
translations.hypothesis: Mwalimu wa picha alitolewa hospitalini la Ronald Reagan katika UCLA, ambapo baadaye alifariki dunia.

translations.source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.reference: Aliripotiwa kuwa katika miaka yake ya 20. Katika taarifa, Bierber alisema “Ingawa sikuwako au kuhusika na ajali hii mbaya moja kwa moja, mawazo na maombi yangu yako kwa familia ya muathiriwa.”
translations.hypothesis: Kimsipotajwa, alikuwa umri wa miaka 20. Katika taarifa, Bieber alisema: "[Ingawa sikuwepo wala sikojihusisha moja kwa moja na tukio hili, mioo na maombi yangu ni pamoja na familia ya kibali."

translations.source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.reference: Tovuti ya habari za burudani TMZ inaelewa mpiga picha alisimamisha gari katika upande mwingine wa Sepulveda Boulevard na akajaribu kupiga picha za kizuizi cha polisi kabla ya kuvuka barabara na kuendelea, akamfanya afisa wa polisi wa California Highway Patrol aliyekuwa akiendesha kizuizi kumwamrisha kurudi katika upande mwingine, mara mbili.
translations.hypothesis: Tovuti ya habari za burudani, TMZ, inaelewa kwamba mmoja wa piga picha alisimama gari lake upande wa mwaya wa Sepulveda na alijaribu kuchukua picha za polisi wakimwomba, kabla ya kujuwa mwaya na kuendelea, ambapo maafisa wa Polisi wa Barabara wa California, waliendesha uondoaji wa trafiki, walamtaka kurudi.

translations.source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.reference: Kwa mujibu wa polisi, dereva wa gari lililomgonga mpigaji picha huenda akakabiliwa na mashtaka ya jinai.
translations.hypothesis: Kulingana na polisi, dereva wa gari ambalo lilimshambulisha mhariri, hali ya kukabili hatari, ni ndefu.

translations.source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.reference: Huku medali kumi na nane zikipatikana kwa siku, baadhi ya nchi zimekosa kufikia jukwaa la medali.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa kuwa kuna vyumba vya tuzo vyote 18 pekee kila siku, nchi kadhaa hazikuweza kupata tuzo.

translations.source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.reference: Ni pamoja na Uholanzi, huku Anna Jochemsen akimaliza wa tisa katika kitengo cha kusimama cha wanawake kwenye Super-G jana, na Ufini huku Katja Saarinen akimaliza wa kumi katika tukio hilo hilo.
translations.hypothesis: Haya ni pamoja na Uholanzi, ambapo Anna Jochemsen alifuzu nafasi ya tano katika mashindano ya Super-G kwa wanawake jana, na Finland, ambapo Katja Saarinen alifuzu nafasi ya sita katika shindano hilo.

translations.source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Mitchell Gourley wa Australia alimaliza wa kumi na mmoja katika kitengo cha kusimama cha wanaume cha Super-G. Mshindani wa Cheki Oldrich Jelinek alimaliza wa kumi na sita katika kitengo cha kuketi cha wanaume cha Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Mitchell Gourley kutoka Australia alimalizia katika nafasi ya kwanza kwenye mashindano ya Super-G kwa wanaume. Mshindani kutoka Czech, Oldrich Jelinek, alimalizia katika nafasi ya sita kwenye mashindano ya Super-G kwa wanaume.

translations.source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.reference: Arly Velasquez wa Meksiko alimaliza kwa nafasi ya kumi na tano katika seti ya Super-G ya wanaume. Ukumbi wa Adam wa Zilandi Mpya lilimaliza wa tisa katika msimamo wa Super-G wa wanaume.
translations.hypothesis: Arly Velasquez kutoka Mexico alimalizia nafasi ya 15 katika mashindano ya Super-G kwa watumiaji wa viti. Adam Hall kutoka New Zealand alimalizia nafasi ya 9 katika mashindano ya Super-G kwa watumiaji wa majiko.

translations.source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Mtelezaji wa theluji asiyeona vizuri kutoka Poland Maciej Krezel na mwelekezi wake Anna Ogarzynska walimaliza wa kumi na tatu katika Super-G. Jong Seork Park kutoka Korea Kusini alimaliza wa ishirini na nne katika kikundi cha wanaume cha kuketi cha Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: Athleti wa Poland, Maciej Krezel, ambaye ana ulemavu wa kuona, pamoja na mwongozo wake, Anna Ogarzynska, walishinda nafasi ya 13 katika mashindano ya Super-G. Athleti wa Korea Kusini, Jong Seork Park, alishinda nafasi ya 24 katika mashindano ya Super-G kwa wanaume.

translations.source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.reference: Walinda amani wa Umoja wa Mataifa, ambao waliwasili Haiti baada ya mtetemeko wa ardhi wa 2010, wanalaumiwa kwa ueneaji wa ugonjwa huo ulioanza karibu na kambi ya kikosi hicho.
translations.hypothesis: Wanajeshi wa Umoja wa Mataifa, ambao alifika nchini Haiti baada ya earthquake ya 2010, wanaziwa kwa janga hilo, ambalo lilianza karibu na eneo ambapo wanajeshi walikuwa wakiishi.

translations.source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.reference: Kulingana na shtaka hilo, uchafu kutoka kwenye kambi ya Umoja wa Mataifa haukutakaswa vizuri, hivyo kusababisha bakteria kuingia kwenye tawi la Mto Artibonite, mojawapo ya mito mikubwa sana ya Haiti.
translations.hypothesis: Kulingana na kesi hiyo, mchongo kutoka kambi ya Umoja wa Mataifa hauliwa vizuri, na hivyo kusababisha bakteria kuingia kwenye mto wa Artibonite, ambao ni mto kubwa wa Haiti.

translations.source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.reference: Kabla ya kufika kwa vikosi, Haiti haikuwa imekumbana na shida zinazohusiana na magonjwa tangu miaka ya 1800.
translations.hypothesis: Kabla ya kuwasili kwa askari, Haiti hakuliwa na matatizo yanayohusiana na ugonjwa tangu miaka ya 1800.

translations.source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.reference: Taasisi ya Haki na Demokrasia ya Haiti imerejelea utafiti huru ambao unapendekeza kwamba kikosi cha kulinda amani cha Kinepali cha Umoja wa Mataifa kilileta ugonjwa huo Haiti bila kujua.
translations.hypothesis: Chuo cha Haiti cha Umoja na Demokrasia kinaitumia utafiti wa kibinafsi ambao zinaonyesha kwamba kikosi cha Umoja wa Mataifa cha utulivu kutoka Nepal, bila kujua, kilileza ugonjwa huko Haiti.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.reference: Danielle Lantagne, mtaalamu wa UN kuhusu ugonjwa huo, alisema kuna uwezekano mkurupuko huo ulisababishwa na walinda amani.
translations.hypothesis: Danielle Lantagne, mtaalamu wa Umoja wa Mataifa kuhusu ugonjwa huo, alisema kuwa mlio, ambao walikuwa wamejiokoa, ndiyo walikuwa wahusika katika mlio huo.

translations.source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.reference: Hamilton alithibitisha kwamba Chuo cha Howard kilimpokea mgonjwa akiwa katika hali thabiti.
translations.hypothesis: Hamilton alithibitisha kwamba Hospitali ya Chuo Kikuu cha Howard ilipokea mgonjwa katika hali njema.

translations.source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.reference: Mgonjwa alikuwa Nijeria, ambako baadhi ya matukio ya virusi vya Ebola yametokea.
translations.hypothesis: Mteja alikuwa amefika Nigeria, ambapo viongozi wa virusi vya Ebola wameonekana.

translations.source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.reference: Hospitali imefuata itifaki ya kudhibiti maambukizi, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutenga mgonjwa kutoka kwa wengine ili kuzuia uwezekano wa kuwaambukiza wengine.
translations.hypothesis: Hospitalo limefuata kanuni za kudhibiti magonjwa, pamoja na kuajisonga mgonjwa kutoka kwa wengine ili kuzuia ugonjwa wa wengine.

translations.source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.reference: Kabla ya The Simpsons Simon alikuwa amefanyia kazi maonyesho kadhaa katika nafasi mbalimbali.
translations.hypothesis: Kabla ya The Simpsons, Simon alifanya kazi katika programu kadhaa katika nafasi mbalimbali.

translations.source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.reference: Katika miaka ya 1980 alishughulikia vipindi kama vile Taxi, Cheers, na Onyesho la Tracy Ullman.
translations.hypothesis: Katika miaka ya 1980, alihusika katika programu za televisheni kama vile Taxi, Cheers, na The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.reference: Mnamo 1989 alisaidia kuunda The Simpsons Pamoja na Brooks na Groening, na ndiye aliyehusika katika kuajiri timu ya kwanza ya uandishi ya kipindi.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo mwaka wa 1989, alisaidia kuunda "The Simpsons" pamoja na Brooks na Groening, na alikuwa jukumu la kukwama timu ya kwanza ya maandishi ya programu hiyo.

translations.source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.reference: Licha ya kutoka kwenye onyesho mwaka wa 1993 alihifadhi cheo cha mtendaji mzalishaji, na kuendelea kupokea makumi ya mamilioni ya dola kwa kila msimu wa mrahaba.
translations.hypothesis: Licha ya kuondoka katika programu hiyo mwaka 1993, alibaki na jukumu la mkurugenzi, na pia alirudishwa pesa za mamilioni kila msimu.

translations.source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.reference: Mapema wakala wa taarifa wa Kichina Xinhua uliripoti utekwaji nyara wa ndege.
translations.hypothesis: Hapo awali, gazeti la habari la China, Xinhua, liliraport kuwa ndege moja ilikuwa imepatwa.

translations.source: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
translations.reference: Kisha ripoti za baadaye zilisema ndege ilipokea tishio la bomu na ikaelekezwa tena Afganistani, na kutua Kandahar.
translations.hypothesis: Baadaye, taarifa za awali ziliripoti kwamba ndege ilipokea hatari ya kundi la kulevya na ilibadilishwa njia na kurudi Afghanistan, ambapo ilifika katika mji wa Kandahar.

translations.source: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
translations.reference: Ripoti za mapema zinasema ndege ilielekezwa tena Afganistani baada ya kunyimwa ruhusa ya kutua katika Urumki.
translations.hypothesis: Taarifa za awali zinaonyesha kwamba ndege hiyo ilitumiwa kurudi Afghanistan baada ya kukataliwa kuandika ndege katika eneo la Ürümqi.

translations.source: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.reference: Ajali za hewani ni kawaida nchini Iran, ambayo ina ndege ambazo huhifadhiwa kihafifu kwa shughuli za kiraia na zile za kijeshi.
translations.hypothesis: Uhalasiko wa ndeo ni wa kawaida katika Iran, ambapo idara ya ndeo ni za zamani na hazifunzika vizuri, kwa matumizi ya usafiri na za kijeshi.

translations.source: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.reference: Vikwazo vya kimataifa vimemaanisha kuwa ndege mpya haiwezi kununuliwa.
translations.hypothesis: Visa vya kimataifa vimewawezesha kwamba ndege mpya hazipatikani.

translations.source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.reference: Mapema wiki hii, helikopta ya polisi ilianguka na kuua watu watatu na kujeruhi wengine watatu.
translations.hypothesis: Jumamosi, ajali ya helikopta ya polisi ilifariki, na kusababisha vifo vya watu watatu na majeraha kwa wengine watatu.

translations.source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.reference: Mwezi uliopita Iran iliona janga la hewani baya zaidi kwa miaka wakati ndege iliyokuwa ikielekea Amenia ilianguka na kuwaua watu wote 168.
translations.hypothesis: Mwezi uliopita, Iran ilipata ajali mbaya zaidi ya ndege katika miaka, ambapo ndege iliyosafiri kwenda Armenia ilikwama, na kusababisha vifo vya 168 wa abiria.

translations.source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.reference: Katika mwezi huo huo ndege nyingine ya abiria ilipita njia yake katika Mashhad na kugonga ukuta, ikawaua watu kumi na saba.
translations.hypothesis: Katika mwezi huo, ndege nyingine pia ilipotea kwenye uwanja wa ndege huko Mashhad, na kugawanya eneo, na kusababisha vifo vya watu 17.

translations.source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.reference: Aerosmith wameghairi maonyesho yaliyobaki katika ziara yao.
translations.hypothesis: Banda la Aerosmith limekataa matayarisho ya matamasha iliyobaki katika safari yao.

translations.source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.reference: Bendi ya muziki wa roki ilikuwa tayari kutembelea Amerika na Canada hadi Septemba 16.
translations.hypothesis: Banda hiyo ya muziki ilikuwa na mpango wa kukaa katika safari katika Marekani na Kanada hadi tarehe 16 Septemba.

translations.source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.reference: Wameghairi ziara baada ya mwimbaji mkuu Steven Tyler kujeruhiwa baada ya kuanguka kutoka kwenye jukwaa wakati wa maonyesho mnamo Agosti 5.
translations.hypothesis: Wamekataza safari baada ya mwanamuziki mkuu, Steven Tyler, kuumia baada ya kukojoa kwenye hatari wakati wa kipindi cha August 5.

translations.source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.reference: Murray alipoteza seti ya kwanza kwa kuvunjwa kwa usawa baada ya wanaume wote kushikilia kila lishe kwenye seti.
translations.hypothesis: Murray alopoteza seti ya kwanza baada ya kumalizia seti, ambapo kila mmoja alifanya kila aina ya mpito.

translations.source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.reference: Del Potro ilikuwa na faida ya mapema katika seti ya pili, lakini hii pia ilihitaji kivunja usawabaada ya kufikia 6-6.
translations.hypothesis: Del Potro alikuwa na faida katika seti ya pili, lakini pia hii ilihitaji ushindi wa 6-6 kabla ya kupata ushindi.

translations.source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.reference: Potro alipokea matibabu begani mwake kwa wakati huu lakini akamudu kurejea kwenye mchezo.
translations.hypothesis: Potro alipokea matibabu kwenye bahari yake, lakini alifanikiwa kurudi katika mchezo.

translations.source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: Mpango ulianza saa 2 na dakika 30 jioni saa za ndani (15.00 UTC)
translations.hypothesis: Programu ilianza saa 8:30 jioni, saa za eneo (15.00 UTC).

translations.source: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.reference: Waimbaji maarufu katika nchi waliwasilisha bhajan, au nyimbo za ibada, kwenye miguu ya Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: Waimama maarufu kutoka kote nchi walitumbuiza nyimbo za kidini, zilizotumiwa kwa heshima kwa Shri Shyam.

translations.source: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Mwimbaji Sanju Sharma alianzisha jioni, akifuatiwa na Jai Shankar Chaoudhary. Alionyesha chhappan bhog bhajan vilevile. Mwimbaji, Raju Khandewal aliandamana naye.
translations.hypothesis: Msanii Sanju Sharma alianza usiku, kufuatia Jai Shankar Choudhary. Pia, walitangaza "chhappan bhog bhajan". Msanii Raju Khandelwal alikuwa anashiriki.

translations.source: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.reference: Kisha, Lakkha Singh akachukua uongozi wa uimbaji wa bhajan.
translations.hypothesis: Kisha, Lakkha Singh alaanza kumshairi bhajans.

translations.source: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.reference: Sahani 108 za Chhappan Bhog (katika Uhindi, vyakula 56 vya aina tofauti tofauti, kama vile peremende, matunda, karanga, na kadhalika ambazo hutozwa kwa miungu) zilipeanwa kwa Baba Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: Plates 108 za Chhappan Bhog (katika Uislamu, kuna vyombo 56 mbalimbali za kula, kama vile, matunda, vyombo, na kadhakati ambazo hutolewa kwa Mungu) zilitumika kwa Baba Shyam.

translations.source: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Lakkha Singh aliwasilisha chhappan bhog bhajan vile vile. Mwimbaji, Raju Khandelwal aliandamana naye.
translations.hypothesis: Lakkha Singh pia alitoa huduma ya "chhappan bhog bhajan". Mwingiliano, Raju Khandelwal, alikuwa anashiriki.

translations.source: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.reference: Katika uwasilishaji mkuu wa Onyesho la Mchezo la Tokyo Alhamisi, Rais wa Nintendo Satoru Iwata alizindua muundo wa kidhibiti cha kiweko kipya cha kampuni hiyo cha Nintendo Revolution.
translations.hypothesis: Katika uzinduzi rasmi wa Maonyesho ya Mchezo ya Tokyo, Rais wa Nintendo, Satoru Iwata, alionyesha muundo wa udhibiti wa console mpya ya Nintendo, ambayo kampuni hiyo itatumia.

translations.source: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.reference: Ifananayo na rimoti ya runinga, kidhibiti hutumia sensa mbili zilizowekwa karibu na runinga ya mtumiaji ili kupata nafasi yake katika sehemu ya pande tatu.
translations.hypothesis: Kifaa hiki, ambacho linaaina kama kalamu ya runinga, hutumia sensor zote mbili zimewekwa karibu na runinga ya mtumiaji ili kupata eneo lake katika nafasi tatu.

translations.source: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.reference: Hii itawaruhusu wachezaji kudhibiti machaguo na misogeo katika michezo ya video kwa kusogeza kifaa hewani.
translations.hypothesis: Hii itatoa wachezaji uwezo wa kudhibiti matendo na harakat katika michezo ya video kwa kupitia kifaa katika anga.

translations.source: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.reference: Giancarlo Fisichella alishindwa kudhibiti gari lake na kulazimika kutamatisha mashindano muda mfupi baada ya kuanza.
translations.hypothesis: Giancarlo Fisichella alipoteza udhibiti wa gari lake na alimaliza mbio mara baada ya kuanza.

translations.source: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.reference: Mwanatimu mwenzake Fernando Alonso alikuwa akiongoza kwa wingi wa mbio hizo, lakini aliumaliza mara tu baada ya kusimama kwa matengenezo, labda kwa sababu ya gurudumu la kulia la mbele kushonwa vibaya.
translations.hypothesis: Mcheza wake, Fernando Alonso, alikuwa naongoza kwa karibu wakati wote wa mbio, lakini alimaliza baada ya kuacha garage, labda kwa sababu gari lake la kulia mbele lilikuwa limeharibika.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.reference: Michael Schumacher alimaliza mbio zake muda mfupi baada ya Alonso, kwa sababu ya uharibifu wa mfumo wa kusimamisha gari, uliosababishwa na mapambano kadhaa wakati wa mbio hizo.
translations.hypothesis: Michael Schumacher alimaliza mbio zake baada ya Alonso, kwa sababu ya uharibifu wa vifaa wakati wa mbio.

translations.source: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.reference: "Ni mrembo sana na huimba vizuri sana, pia", alisema kulingana na manukuu ya kongamano la habari.
translations.hypothesis: "Ana umbile na pia anashinda vizuri," alisema, kulingana na nakala ya mkutano wa waandishi wa habari.

translations.source: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.reference: "Niliguzwa kila wakati tulipofanya mazoezi ya hii, kutoka ndani ya moyo wangu."
translations.hypothesis: "Kila wakati tulipoendesha mazoezi, naona furaha kubwa, kutoka kwa moyo wangu."

translations.source: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.reference: Karibu dakika 3 katika uzinduzi, kamera ya ndani ya chombo ilionyesha vipande vingi vya sponji ya kizio vikiachana na tanki ya mafuta.
translations.hypothesis: Kira ya dakika 3 baada ya uzinduzi, kamera iliyopo kwenye ndege ilionyesha kwamba vifaa kadhaa vya uchafu vimeanguka kutoka kwenye chombo cha mafuta.

translations.source: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, haidhaniwi zilisababisha uharibifu wowote wa gari.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, hakuna ushahidi kwamba ziliathiri gari huyo.

translations.source: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.reference: Mkuu wa mpango wa gari wa Nasa N. Wayne Halle Mdogo alisema povu lilianguka "baada ya muda tunaojali."
translations.hypothesis: Mkuu wa programu ya ndege za NASA, N. Wayne Hale Jr., alisema kwamba "foam ilififia baada ya wakati ambao tunaghadharika."

translations.source: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.reference: Dakika tano ndani ya onyesho upepo unaanza kuingia, takriban dakika moja baadaye, upepo unafikia kilomita 70 kwa saa…kisha mvua inakuja, lakini kwa nguvu na kubwa sana kiasi kwamba inapiga ngozi yako kama sindano, kisha mvua ya mawe ikaanguka toka angani, watu wakapata wasiwasi na kupiga mayowe na kukanyangana.
translations.hypothesis: baada ya dakika tano, upepo huanza, dakika moja baadaye, upepo unapunguka hadi 70km/s... kisha, mvua huanza, lakini iko kali na kubwa, na inatumbukiza ngozi kama danda, kisha, barafu huanza kuanguka kutoka angani, watu wanaogopa na kuita, na kuendesha kwa njia tofauti.

translations.source: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.reference: Nilimpoteza dadangu na rafiki yake, na nikiwa njiani kulikuwa na watu wawili wenye ulemavu kwenye viti vya magurudumu, watu waliruka tu juu yao na kuwasukuma," Armand Versace alisema.
translations.hypothesis: Mimi nilopoteza shuja yangu na rafiki yake, na wakati wa kwenda, niliona watu wawili waliokuwa na ulemavu na wanaotumia viti, na watu walikuwa wakipita na kuwasaidia. "Armand Versace alisema.

translations.source: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.reference: NHK pia iliripoti kuwa kiwanda cha nguvu za nyuklia cha Kashiwazaki Kariwa katika wilaya ya Niigata kilikuwa kikifanya kazi kwa njia ya kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: NHK pia iliripoti kwamba, kitengo cha umeme la nyuklia la Kashiwazaki Kariwa katika eneo la Niigata, lilikuwa kinatumika kwa kawaida.

translations.source: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.reference: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. iliripoti hakukuwa na athari zozote kutokana na mtetemeko wa ardhi na kwamba tanuri Nambari 1 na 2 katika kiwanda chake cha nguvu za nyuklia cha Shika zilikuwa zimezimwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kampuni ya Nguvu ya Umeme ya Hokuriku iliripoti kwamba hakuna athari za earthquake, na kwamba реакторы 1 na 2 katika kituo chao cha nguvu ya Shika zimefungwa.

translations.source: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.reference: Inaripotiwa kwamba takribani kaya 9400 katika eneo hazina maji na takribani 100 hazina umeme.
translations.hypothesis: Inatajwa kwamba makwa 9400 katika eneo hilo hawana maji, na makwa takriban 100 hawana umeme.

translations.source: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.reference: Baadhi ya barabara zimeharibiwa, huduma za reli kukatishwa katika maeneo yaliyoathirika, na uwanja wa ndege wa wilaya ya Ishikawa unabaki kufungwa.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya barabara zimeharibika, huduma ya reli imesimama katika eneo lililotathminiwa, na uwanja wa ndege wa Noto katika eneo la Ishikawa bado hajasajiri.

translations.source: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.reference: Bomu moja lililipuka nje ya ofisi ya gavana mkuu.
translations.hypothesis: Kuna bomu lililotoboka nje ya ofisi ya wakala wa eneo.

translations.source: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.reference: Mabomu matatu zaidi yalilipuka karibu na majengo ya serikali katika kipindi cha saa tatu.
translations.hypothesis: Kifo zaidi la bomu lilifuaji karibu na majengo ya serikali katika kipindi cha saa mbili.

translations.source: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.reference: Baadhi ya ripoti zilionyesha idadi rasmi ya vifo kuwa vinane, na ripoti rasmi zinathibitisha kulikuwa na majeruhi hadi 30; lakini idadi kamili bado hazijajulikana.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya taarifa zinaonyesha kuwa idadi ya vifo ni kumi, na taarifa rasmi zina uthibitisho kuwa hadi 30 wamejeruhiwa; lakini idadi kamili bado haijafahamika.

translations.source: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.reference: Asidi sayanuri na melanini zilipatikana kwenye sampuli za mkojo kutoka kwa wanyamavipenzi waliokufa baada ya kula chakula kichafu cha wanyamavipenzi.
translations.hypothesis: Kwao asidi ya cyanuric na melamine zilitathuliwa katika sampuli za madaji kutoka kwa wanyama waliopata maumivu baada ya kula chakula cha wanyama kilichotengwa.

translations.source: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.reference: Kampaundi hizo mbili humenyuka pamojakutengeneza fuwele ambazo zinaweza kuzuia kazi za figo, watafiti chuoni walisema.
translations.hypothesis: Chembezi hizi mbili zinachangana na kuunda vitu vya kioo ambavyo vinaweza kupunguza kazi ya ubongo, watafiti katika chuo kikuu wamesema.

translations.source: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.reference: Watafiti waliona uwele zilizoundwa katika mkojo wa paka kwa kuongezewa melamine na asidi ya sianiuriki.
translations.hypothesis: Watafiti waliona vito vilivyotengenezwa katika urina ya paka kwa kutumia melamine na asidi ya cyanuric.

translations.source: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.reference: Mchanganyiko wa fuwele hizi unalingana na wa zile zinazopatikana kwenye mkojo wa wanyamavipenzi walioathiriwa ikilinganishwa kutumia uchunguzi wa miale isiyoonekana (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: Muundo wa kristali hizi unafanana na wale waliopatikana katika madai ya wanyama waliopata magonjwa, wakati wa kutumia spectroscopy ya infrared (FTIR).

translations.source: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.reference: Sijui kama unatambua hili au la, lakini nyingi ya bidhaa kutoka Marekani ya Kati ziliingia humu nchini bila kulipiwa ushuru.
translations.hypothesis: Sijui kama unajua au la, lakini karibu vyombo vya kibiashara kutoka Amerika ya Kati vimetiwa malipo wakati wa kuingia nchini.

translations.source: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.reference: Na bado asilimia themanini ya bidhaa zetu zilitozwa ushuru kupitia orodha za ushuru katika nchi za Marekani ya Kati.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, asilimia 80 ya bidhaa zetu ziliwajibishwa kupitia mapato katika nchi za Amerika ya Kati. Tunakutumia.

translations.source: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.reference: Hilo halikuonekana kuwa na maana kwangu; hakika halikuwa la haki.
translations.hypothesis: Hiyo hakuna kuonekana kuwa na maana; hakika si haki.

translations.source: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.reference: Ninachosema kwa watu ni kwamba nyinyi mtutendee jinsi tunavyowatendea.
translations.hypothesis: Kama ninasema kwa watu ni kwamba, "tumsaidie kwa njia ambayo sisi tunawasaidia."

translations.source: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.reference: Gavana wa California Arnold Schwarzenegger alisaini kuwa sheria mswada unaopiga marufuku uuzwaji au ukodishwaji wa michezo ya video yenye vurugu kwa wasiofikia utu uzima.
translations.hypothesis: Waziri wa California, Arnold Schwarzenegger, alituma sheria ambayo inazuia uuzaji au kukodisha michezo ya video yenye ukiukaji, kwa watoto wadogo.

translations.source: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.reference: Mswada huo unahitaji michezo ya video yenye vurugu inayouzwa katika jimbo la Kalifornia kuwa na lebo iliyoandikwa "18" na kufanya mauzo yake kwa watoto wadogo kuwa na adhabu ya faini ya dola 1000 kwa kila kosa.
translations.hypothesis: Wapi hili inahitaji michezo ya video yenye matumizi ya ujerumani ambazo zinauzwa katika jimbo la California, kuwa na lebo inayosema "18", na kuwezesha uuzaji wao kwa mtu mdogo, na kuwapa adhabu ya faini ya $1000 kwa kila kesi.

translations.source: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.reference: Kiongozi wa Mashtaka ya Umma, Wakili Kier Starmer, alitoa taarifa asubuhi ya leo akitangaza kushtakiwa kwa Huhne na Pryce.
translations.hypothesis: Mkurugenzi wa Mashtaka, Kier Starmer QC, alitoa taarifa leo, akitangaza kwamba Huhne na Pryce wote watajibiwa mashtaka.

translations.source: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.reference: Huhne amejiuzulu na nafasi yake katika Baraza la Mawaziri itachukuliwa na mbunge Ed Davey. Mbunge Norman Lamb anatarajiwa kuchukua kazi ya Waziri wa Biashara inayoachwa na Davey.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne amtoka, na atachezwa katika kabineti na Ed Davey, mpya. Norman Lamb, mpya, anatarajiwa kuchukua nafasi ya Mheshimiwa Huhne kama mwanasiasa wa biashara.

translations.source: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.reference: Huhne na Pryce wameratibiwa kutokea katika Mahakama ya Hakimu ya Westminster mnamo Februari 16.
translations.hypothesis: Huhne na Pryce wamejiandaa kuonekana katika Mahakama ya Westminster mnamo Februari 16.

translations.source: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.reference: Vifo vilikuwa vya Nicholas Alden, 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback alikuwa dereva.
translations.hypothesis: Watu waliopoteza maisha ni Nicholas Alden, mwenye umri wa miaka 25, na Zachary Cuddeback, mwenye umri wa miaka 21. Cuddeback alikuwa dereva.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.reference: Edgar Veguilla alipata majeraha ya mkono na taya huku Kristoffer Schneider akihitaji upasuaji wa kurekebisha uso wake.
translations.hypothesis: Edgar Veguilla alipata majeraha kwenye mkono na kinywa, wakati Kristoffer Schneider alihitaji upasuaji wa marejesho kwa uso wake.

translations.source: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.reference: Silaha ya Uka ilikosa kufanya kazi huku ikilenga kichwa cha mwanamume wa tano. Schneider ana maumivu yanayoendelea, upofu katika jicho moja, hana sehemu ya fuvu na uso uliotengenezwa kwa titani.
translations.hypothesis: Silaha ya Uka ilifeli wakati ilipoongozwa kwenye kichwa cha mtu wa tano. Schneider ana maumivu ya muda, amevunjika jicho, ana sehemu iliyopotea kwenye ubongo, na uso wake umerefundishwa kwa matumizi ya chuma.

translations.source: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.reference: Schneider alitoa ushahidi kupitia kiungo cha video kutoka makazi ya Jeshi la Anga la Amerika katika nchi yake.
translations.hypothesis: Schneider alishuhudia kupitia mtandao wa video kutoka kwenye kituo cha USAF katika nchi yake.

translations.source: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.reference: Zaidi ya tukio la Jumatatu, Carpanedo alishindana katika mbio mbiliza kibinafsi katika Ubingwa.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo siku ya Jumanne, Carpanedo pia alishindana katika mbili za mashindano za mtu binafsi katika mashindano.

translations.source: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.reference: Yake ya kwanza ilikuwa Slalom, ambapo alipata Hakumaliza katika mbio zake za kwanza. 36 wa washindani 116 walikuwa na matokeo sawa katika mbio hizo.
translations.hypothesis: Kazi yake ya kwanza ilikuwa katika mashindano ya Slalom, ambapo alipata matokeo ya "Haisomeki" katika safari yake ya kwanza. Wakandarasi 36 kati ya 116 walipata matokeo sawa katika mashindano hizo.

translations.source: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.reference: Alimaliza wa kumi katika mbio yake nyingine, Giant Slalom, kwenye kitengo cha kuketi cha wanawake kwa muda uliojumuishwa wa ukimbiaji wa 4:41.30, dakika 2:11.60 polepole kuliko aliyemaliza katika nafasi ya kwanza Mwaustralia Claudia Loesch na dakika 1:09.02 polepole kuliko aliyemaliza katika nafasi ya tisa Gyongyi Dani wa Hungaria.
translations.hypothesis: السباق lingine, ambao ni "Giant Slalom", uliwawasa, alishinda nafasi ya kumi katika kategoria ya wanawake waliokuwa walaji, na muda wa jumla wa 4:41.30. Hii ilikuwa dakika 2:11.60 ya karibu zaidi kuliko mshindi wa kwanza, Claudia Loesch kutoka Austria, na dakika 1:09.02 ya karibu zaidi kuliko Gyöngyi Dani kutoka Hungary, ambaye alishinda nafasi ya tano.

translations.source: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.reference: Wazungu wanne kwenye kundi la wanawake walishindwa kumaliza mbio zao, na 45 ya 117 walifeli na kushindwa kupata nafasi kwenye mbio hizo.
translations.hypothesis: Waiskaji nne katika kategoria ya wasichana walio, hawafanikiwa kumaliza safari zao, na 45 kati ya waskaji 117 kwa ujumla katika mashindano ya Giant Slalom, hawakufanya nafasi katika mashindano.

translations.source: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.reference: Polisi wa Madhya Pradesh walikipata kipakatalishi na simu ya rununu iliyoibwa.
translations.hypothesis: Polisi wa Madhya Pradesh walipata kompyuta na simu ambazo zilichoibiwa.

translations.source: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.reference: Naibu Inspekta Jenerali D K Arya alisema, "tumewakamata watu watano waliomnajisi mwanamke huyo Mswisi na tukapata rununu na kompyuta ndogo yake."
translations.hypothesis: Naibu Mkurugenzi Mkuu D K Arya alisema, "Tumeziima watu sita ambao waligharimu mwanamke wa Uswisi, na tumeipata simu na kompyuta yake".

translations.source: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: Washtakiwa wanatajwa kamaBaba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar, na Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: Wachunguzwa wameelezwa kuwa Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar na Vishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.reference: Mkuu wa polisi Chandra Shekar Solanki alisema mshtakiwa alitokea mahakamani na uso uliofunikwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kamishna wa polisi, Chandra Shekhar Solanki, alisema kwamba wahalifu walikuja mahakama kwa uso wa vilizi.

translations.source: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.reference: Ingawa watu watatu walikuwa ndani ya nyumba wakati gari liliigonga, hakuna aliyejeruhiwa.
translations.hypothesis: Licha ya kwamba watu watatu walikuwa ndani ya nyumba wakati gari lilihit, hakuna ambaye alijeruhiwa.

translations.source: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, dereva alipata majeraha mabaya kwenye kichwa.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, dereva alipata majeraha makubwa kwenye kichwa.

translations.source: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.reference: Barabara ambamo mgongano ulifanyika ilifungwa kwa muda wakati huduma za dharura walipokuwa wakiokoa dereva kutoka kwa Audi TT nyekundu.
translations.hypothesis: Barabara ambapo tukio hilo lilitokea, ilisafishwa kwa muda wakati huduma za dharura walitolea dereva kutoka kwenye Audi TT ya rangi nyekundu.

translations.source: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: Mwanzoni alikuwa amelazwa kwenye Hospitali ya James Paget katika Great Yarmouth.
translations.hypothesis: Alianzishwa matibabu katika Hospitali ya James Paget huko Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.reference: Baadaye alihamishiwa Hospitalini Addenbrooke katika Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: Baadaye, alitafutwa kwenda Hospitali ya Addenbrooke's huko Cambridge.

translations.source: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.reference: Tangu wakati huo Adekoya amekuwa katika Mahakama ya Edinburg Sheriff kwa mashtaka ya kumuua mwanaye.
translations.hypothesis: Adekoya, tangu wakati huo, amekuwa katika Mahakama ya Sheriffi ya Edinburgh, akishutumuwa kwa mauaji ya mwanawe.

translations.source: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.reference: Yuko korokoroni akisubiri mashtaka na kesi, lakini ushahidi wowote wa walioshuhudia huenda ukaathirika vibaya kwa sababu picha yake imechapishwa sana mahali kwingi.
translations.hypothesis: Anaendelea kuwa chini ya mashtaka, lakini ushahidi kutoka kwa watu walishuhudia unaweza kuwa hatari, kwani picha yake imetolewa sana.

translations.source: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.reference: Hii ni desturi kwingineko Uingereza lakini haki ya Kiskoti hufanya kazi kwa njia tofauti na mahakama zimeangalia uchapishaji wa picha kama wenye ubaguzi.
translations.hypothesis: Hii ni mbinu ya kawaida katika sehemu nyingine za Uingereza, lakini utawala wa Scotland kina mbinu tofauti, na mahakama zimeona kwamba kuchapisha picha inaweza kuwa hatari.

translations.source: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.reference: Profesa Pamela Ferguson wa Chuo Kikuu cha Dundee anasema "wanahabari wanaonekana kujihatarisha kwa kuchapisha picha n.k. za watuhumiwa."
translations.hypothesis: Profesa Pamela Ferguson kutoka Chuo Kikuu cha Dundee anasema, "Wajournalisti wanaonekana kuwa katika hatari kubwa ikiwa wanaandika picha na vitendo vya watu wanaoshtakiwa."

translations.source: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.reference: Crown Office, ambayo husimamia mashtaka, imeashiria kwa wanahabari kwamba hakuna maoni ya ziada yatakayotolewa angalau hadi mashtaka yafanyike.
translations.hypothesis: Ofisi ya Mfalme, ambayo ni jukumu rasmi katika mashtaka, imetoa taarifa kwa waandishi wa habari kwamba hakutakuwa na maelezo zaidi hadi hatua ya kuwashtaki.

translations.source: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.reference: Hati hiyo, kulingana na fununu, itarejelea mzozo wa mipaka, ambayo Palestina inataka iwe na msingi wa mipaka kabla ya Vita vya 1967 vya Mashariki ya Kati.
translations.hypothesis: Kulingana na taarifa, hati hiyo itazungumzia mgogoro wa mipaka, ambao Palestina wanataka kulingana na mipaka kabla ya vita vya Mashariki ya kati mnamo 1967.

translations.source: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.reference: Mada nyingine zilizoshughulikiwa inaripotiwa zinatia ndani hali ya baadaye ya Yerusalemu ambayo ni takatifu kwa mataifa yote mawili na suala la Bonde la Yordani.
translations.hypothesis: Mada zingine zilizojadiliwa zimejumuisha hali ya siku zijazo ya Yerusalemu, ambayo ni muhimu kwa pande zote, na pia masuala ya Mbuga ya Jordan.

translations.source: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.reference: Israeli inadai kuendelezwa kwa uwepo wa kijeshi katika bonde hilo kwa miaka kumi pindi mkataba utakapotiwa saini huku PA ikikubali kuondoa uwepo huo kwa miaka mitano tu.
translations.hypothesis: Israel inataka kuwa na uwezo wa kijeshi wa muda mrefu katika eneo hilo kwa miaka kumi, baada ya mkataba kufungwa, huku PA ikikubaliana kuondoka katika eneo hilo kwa miaka mitano pekee.

translations.source: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.reference: Walenga shabaha katika jaribio la ziada la kudhibiti visumbufu walipaswa kusimamiwa na walinzi, kwani jaribio lingefuatiliwa na ufanisi wake kutathminiwa.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wanaotumia dawa za kupunguza wadudu katika jaribio hilo, walipaswa kuwa chini ya usimamizi wa karibu na maafisa, kwani jaribio hilo lilikuwa linachunguzwa na ufanisi wake ulikuwa na thamani.

translations.source: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.reference: Kwa kushirikiana na NPWS na Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, wajitoleaji waliohitimu waliandikishwa, chini ya mpango wa uwindaji wa Sporting Shooters Association.
translations.hypothesis: Kupitia ushirikiano kati ya NPWS na Chama cha Watoaji Risasi za Kimfuo huko Australia (NSW) Inc, vijana waliohitimu walajuliwa, chini ya programu ya uhamishoni ya Chama cha Watoaji Risasi za Kimfuo.

translations.source: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.reference: Kwa mujibu wa Mick O'Flynn, Kaimu Mkurugenzi wa Uhifadhi wa Mbuga na Urithi katika NPWS, walenga shabaha hao wanne walioteuliwa kwa operesheni ya kwanza ya upigaji risasi walipokea mafunzo na maagizo kamili ya usalama.
translations.hypothesis: Kulingana na Mick O'Flynn, Afisa Mkuu wa Hifadhi na Utamaduni katika NPWS, wageni nne waliyochaguliwa kwa shughuli ya kwanza walipokea mafunzo kamili kuhusu usalama na mafunzo.

translations.source: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.reference: Martelly aliapisha Baraza mpya la muda la Uchaguzi la (CEP) la wanachama tisa jana.
translations.hypothesis: Martelly alitangaza jumuia mpya ya Baraza la Uchaguzi la Wadhamini (CEP) la wanachama nane jana.

translations.source: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.reference: Ni CEP ya tano ya Martelly katika miaka minne.
translations.hypothesis: Hii ni mara ya tano kwa Martelly kuwa rais wa CEP katika kipindi cha miaka minne.

translations.source: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.reference: Mwezi uliopita tume ya rais ilipendekeza kujiuzulu kwa CEP iliyotangulia kama sehemu ya kifurushi cha hatua za kusogeza nchi kuelekea uchaguzi mpya.
translations.hypothesis: Mwezi uliopita, tume ya rais ilipendekeza kwamba mkurugenzi wa zamani wa CEP, lazima atoe afya kama moja ya hatua za kupunguza nchi kuelekea uchaguzi mpya.

translations.source: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.reference: Tume ilikuwa jibu la Martelly kwa maandamano yaliyoenea dhidi ya utawala ambayo yalianza mnamo Oktoba.
translations.hypothesis: Kamati hiyo ilikuwa ni jibu la Martelly kwa maandamano ya kila kinyo cha upinzani, ambayo ilianza mwezi Oktoba.

translations.source: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.reference: Maandamano hayo ambayo wakati mwingine huwa jeuri yalianzishwa na ukosefu wa kuwa na uchaguzi, ambapo mwingine ulichelewa tangu 2011.
translations.hypothesis: Mitano ya maandamano, ambayo wakati mwingine ilikuwa na vurudhu, ilianza kutokana na kutofaulu kutekeleza uchaguzi, ambapo baadhi ilikuwa tayari tangu 2011.

translations.source: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
translations.reference: Takriban matukio 60 ya iPod zenye kasoro kutoa joto jingi yameripotiwa, hivyo kusababisha jumla ya mioto sita na kuwaacha watu wanne na majeraha madogo ya kuchomeka.
translations.hypothesis: Kuna matukio takribani 60 za iPod ambazo hazifanya kazi, na kusababisha moto sita, na kuacha watu nne na majeraha kidogo.

translations.source: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.reference: Wizara ya Uchumi, Biashara na Viwanda ya Japani (METI) ilisema ilijua ajali 27 zilizohusiana na vifaa hivyo.
translations.hypothesis: Wizara ya Uchumi, Biashara na Viwanda ya Japan (METI) ilitangaza kuwa, wameelewa kuhusu 27 tukio ambazo zilihusisha vifaa hivyo.

translations.source: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.reference: Wiki iliyopita, METI ilitangaza kwamba Apple ilikuwa imewaarifu kuhusu matukio 34 ya ziada ya utoaji wa joto jingi, ambayo kampuni hiyo ilisema "hayakuwa makubwa."
translations.hypothesis: Miaka iliyopita, METI ilitangaza kwamba Apple imewahakikishia kuwa kuna matukio 34 zaidi ya kupita, ambayo kampuni ilizitaja kama "si muhimu."

translations.source: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.reference: Wizara hiyo ilijibu kwa kuita kuhairishwa kwa ripoti na Apple kuwa kwa "kusikitisha sana."
translations.hypothesis: Wizara ilijibu kwa kuitaja "kuchelewa kutolewa kwa ripoti na Apple" kama "jambo la kutisha sana."

translations.source: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.reference: Tetemeko la ardhi lilipiga Mariana saa 7 dakika 19 asubuhi wakati wa ndani (saa 9 dakika 19 usiku GMT Ijumaa).
translations.hypothesis: Ghafla hiyo ilitokea katika eneo la Mariana saa 07:19 mchana (saa 09:19 jioni, Alhamisi).

translations.source: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.reference: Ofisi ya udhibiti wa dharura ya Marianas Kaskazini ilisema kwamba hakuna madhara yaliyoripotiwa katika taifa.
translations.hypothesis: Ofisi ya usimamizi wa dharura ya Marianas ya Kaskazini ilitangaza kuwa hakuna uharibifu ulioelezwa katika nchi hiyo.

translations.source: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.reference: Pia, Kituo cha Onyo ya Tsunami cha Pasifiki kilisema kuwa hakukuwa na dalili ya Tsunami.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, Kituo cha Uhakiki la Majangili cha Pasifiki kilitangaza kuwa hakuna dalili za majangili.

translations.source: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.reference: Polisi wa kitambo wa Filipino amewateka nyara watalii wa Hong Kong kwa kuteka basi lao katika Manila, mji mkuu wa Ufilipino.
translations.hypothesis: Mwanajeshi wa zamani wa polisi kutoka Philippines amewahabishi watalii kutoka Hong Kong kwa wanyonge, baada ya kuwakamata basi lao huko Manila, mji mkuu wa Philippines.

translations.source: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.reference: Rolando Mendoza alifyatua bunduki yake ya M16 kwa watalii.
translations.hypothesis: Rolando Mendoza alishuti na bunduki yake ya M16 kuelekea watalii.

translations.source: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.reference: Mateka kadhaa wamenusuriwa na angalau sita wamethibitishwa kufa kufikia sasa.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wengi waliokuwa makali wamekuwa salama, na hadi sasa, watu sita wameathirika.

translations.source: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.reference: Mateka sita, wakiwemo watoto na wazee, waliachiliwa mapema kama vile wapiga picha wa Ufilipino.
translations.hypothesis: Mitia miwili, pamoja na watoto na wazee, waliachiliwa mapema, pamoja na wapiga picha wa Filipino.

translations.source: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.reference: Wapiga picha baadaye walichukua nafasi ya mwanamke mzee kwani alihitaji kwenda haja. Mendoza alivamiwa kwa risasi.
translations.hypothesis: Baadaye, waandaji wa picha walachukua nafasi ya mwanamke wa miaka, kwani alihitaji kuenda kwenye choo. Mendoza alatulishwa risasi.

translations.source: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.reference: Liggins alifuata nyayo za babake na kujiunga na kazi ya udaktari.
translations.hypothesis: Liggins, kama baba yake, alifuata njia yake na alaanza kazi katika umaskini.

translations.source: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.reference: Alijifunza kuwa mkunga na akaanza kufanya kazi katika Hospitali ya Kitaifa ya Wanawake ya Auckland mnamo 1959.
translations.hypothesis: Alipata mafunzo kama daktari wa ujana na alianza kufanya kazi katika Hospitali ya Taasisi ya Wanawake huko Auckland mnamo 1959.

translations.source: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.reference: Alipokuwa akifanya kazi hospitalini, Liggins alianza kuchunguza uchungu wa mapema wa uzazi katika muda wake wa ziada.
translations.hypothesis: Huku alikuwa anafanya kazi hospitaloni, Liggins alianza kuchunguza uhusiano mapema, wakati wa wakati wake wa huru.

translations.source: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.reference: Utafiti wake ulionyesha kwamba kama homoni ingetumiwa, ingeongeza kasi ya ukuaji wa mapafu ya mtoto.
translations.hypothesis: Utafiti wake ulionyesha kwamba, iwapo homoni itapatikana, itasaidia kuendeleza matukio ya ndani ya mtoto.

translations.source: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.reference: Xinhua aliripoti kwamba wachunguzi wa serikali walipata vifaa vya 'sanduku nyeusi' vya kurekodi matukio kwenye ndege siku ya Jumatano.
translations.hypothesis: Xinhua iliripoti kwamba maafisa wa serikali wamepatia vyombo vya kurekodi 'black box' vywili siku ya Jumatano.

translations.source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.reference: Mabondia wenzake pia walimuombeleza Luna.
translations.hypothesis: Wanaogopesa pia walitoa heshima kwa Luna.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.reference: Tommy Dreamer alisema, “Luna alikuwa Malkia wa kwanza wa Kukithiri. Meneja wangu wa kwanza. Luna aliaga dunia mnamo usiku wa miezi miwili. Kipekee kama alivyo tu. Mwanamke hodari.”
translations.hypothesis: Tommy Dreamer alisema "Luna alikuwa Mfalme wa Kwanza wa Extreme. Mkurugenzi wangu wa kwanza. Luna alifariki usiku wa miezi miwili. Yeye alikuwa mtu wa kipekee, sawa na yeye. Mwanamke mwenye nguvu."

translations.source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.reference: Justin “Goldust” Runnels ametoa maoni kwamba “Luna alikuwa mdhaifu kama mimi … labda hata zaidi … umpende na utamkosa… kwa matumaini yupo mahali pazuri.”
translations.hypothesis: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels alitaja kwamba "Luna alikuwa sawa na mimi... labda hata zaidi... mpendaji na nitamwomba sana... natumai kuwa yuko mahali pazuri."

translations.source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.reference: Kwa watu 1,400 waliopiga kura ya maoni kabla ya uchaguzi wa 2010 wa shirikisho, wale wanaopinga Australia kuwa jamhuri waliongezeka kwa asilimia 8 tangu mwaka wa 2008.
translations.hypothesis: Kutoka kwa 1,400 watu waliomshughulikia mapema uchaguzi wa kitaifa wa 2010, wale ambao hawakukubali Australia kuwa jamhuri, wameongezeka kwa asilimia 8 tangu 2008.

translations.source: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.reference: Kaimu Waziri Mkuu Julia Gillard alidai wakati wa kampeni ya uchaguzi wa ushirika wa 2010 kwamba aliamini Australia inafaa kuwa jamhuri mwishoni mwa utawala wa Malkia Elizabeth II.
translations.hypothesis: Mkurugenzi Mkuu, Julia Gillard, alitangaza wakati wa kampeni ya uchaguzi wa kitaifa wa 2010 kwamba anadhani Australia iwe republic baada ya uongozi wa Mfalme Elizabeth II.

translations.source: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.reference: Asilimia 34 ya walio kwenye uchunguzi wanashiriki maoni haya, kumtaka Malkia Elizabeth wa II awe malikia wa mwisho wa Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Asilimia 34 ya watu waliochunguza wanasemwa kuwa wanafikiria hivyo, na wanataka kuwa Mfalme Elizabeth II ni mfalme wa mwisho wa Australia.

translations.source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.reference: Katika wingi wa kura, asilimia 29 ya wale waliofanyiwa utafiti wanaamini Australia inapaswa kuwa jamhuri haraka iwezekanavyo, huku asilimia 31 wakiamini Australia haipaswi kamwe kuwa jamhuri.
translations.hypothesis: Katika hatua za uchunguzi, 29% ya watu walioshughulikiwa wanaamini kwamba Australia lazima kuwa jamhuri haraka iwezekanavyo, wakati 31% wanaamini kwamba Australia kamwe haipaswi kuwa jamhuri.

translations.source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.reference: Aliyeshinda nishani ya dhahabu ya Olimpiki alikuwa amepangiwa kuogelea katika mtindo huru wa mita 100 na mita 200 na mbio tatu za kupokezana vijiti katika Michezo ya Jumuiya ya Madola, lakini kwa sababu ya malalamiko yake uzima wake umekuwa na shaka.
translations.hypothesis: Mshindi wa medali ya dhahabu katika Olimpiki alipaswa kushiriki katika mbio za 100m na 200m, na pia katika mbio tatu za mshiriki katika Mashindano ya Commonwealth, lakini kwa sababu ya matatizo yake, afya yake imekuwa kwenye shaka.

translations.source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.reference: Hakuweza kunywa dawa zinazohitajika kutuliza maumivu yake kwani zimepigwa marufuku katika Michezo.
translations.hypothesis: Huyo mtu hajawahi kuwa na uwezo wa kuchukua dawa ambazo zinalenga kupunguza maumivu yake, kwani dawa hizo zimeharamishwa katika mashindano.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.reference: Curtis Cooper, mtaalamu wa hisabati na profesa wa sayansi ya kompyuta katika Chuo Kikuu cha Missouri, amegundua nambari tasa kubwa zaidi kufikia sasa mnamo Januari 25.
translations.hypothesis: Curtis Cooper, mtaalamu wa hisabati na profesa wa sayansi ya kompyuta katika Chuo Kikuu cha Missouri Mashariki, amepatika namba kubwa zaidi inayojulikana hadi sasa, tarehe 25 Januari.

translations.source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.reference: Watu kadhaa walithibitisha uvumbuzi huo kutumia maunzi na programu tofauti kufikia mwanzoni mwa Februari na ikatangazwa mnamo Jumanne.
translations.hypothesis: Watu kadhaa walithibitisha uvumbuzi huo kwa kutumia vifaa na programu tofauti mwishoni mwa Februari, na taarifa hiyo ilitolewa siku ya Jumanne.

translations.source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.reference: Kuna uwezekano kwamba nyotamkia zilikuwa chanzo cha kusafirisha maji katika dunia, pamoja na vitu vilivyo na kaboni vinavyoweza kuunda protini na kusaidia uhai.
translations.hypothesis: كوما, inawezekana kuwa ni chanzo cha maji kupelekwa kwenye ardhi, pamoja na vifaa vya kima, ambavyo vinaweza kuunda protini na kusaidia maisha.

translations.source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.reference: Wanasayansi wanatumai kuelewa jinsi sayari huundwa, hasa jinsi Dunia ilivyoundwa, kwani nyotamkia ziligongana na Dunia kitambo.
translations.hypothesis: Wanasayansi wanatarajia kujua jinsi sayari hujitokeza, haswa jinsi sayari yetu (Yerd) ilijitokeza, kwani sayari za kale ziliingiliana na Yerd.

translations.source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.reference: Cuomo, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, alianza ugavana wake mapema mwaka huu na kutia saini mswada mwezi uliopita wa kuhalalisha ndoa za jinsia moja.
translations.hypothesis: Cuomo, mwenye umri wa miaka 53, alianza kuwa rais wa eneo hilo mapema mwaka huu, na alituma sheria mwezi uliopita ambayo ilitathmini ndoa za watu wa jinsia moja.

translations.source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.reference: Alitaja uvumi huo kama "mapayuko na upumbavu wa kisiasa".
translations.hypothesis: Alieleza kwamba habari hizo ni "mazungumzo na ujinga wa siasa".

translations.source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.reference: Alifikiria kugombea urais mnamo 2016.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wanasema kwamba anawezawania urais katika uchaguzi wa 2016.

translations.source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
