translations.hypothesis: Lakini, kwa njia ya kushangaza, huduma ya simu ni bora zaidi hapa kuliko katika sehemu nyingi zingine za njia, kama vile Pennsylvania Wilds.

translations.source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.reference: Mikate ya Kijerumani ni mizuri mno, na huko Bavaria, ni bora zaidi na tofauti, sawasawa na ile ya jirani yao wa kusini, Austria.
translations.hypothesis: Magari za Ujerumani ni nzuri sana, na katika Bavaria, ni rich na tofauti, sawa na zile za marafiki zao wa kusini, Austria.

translations.source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.reference: Vinyunga vya matunda ni za kawaida, na tufaa zilizopikwa kuwa vinyunga mwaka mzima, na cheri na plamu zikionekana wakati wa msimu wa joto.
translations.hypothesis: Mathukio za matunda ni za kawaida, na matunda kama التفاح يُpwawa katika mathukio wakati wote, na matunda kama الكرز والكمثرى yanaonekana wakati wa majira ya joto.

translations.source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.reference: Nyingi ya bidhaa za kuokwa kutoka Ujerumani huwa lozi, na karanga. Keki zilizo maarufu mara nyingi huambatana vizuri na kikombe cha kahawa kali.
translations.hypothesis: Bidhaa nyingi za magarini za Kijerumani pia zina karanga, karanga, na aina nyingine za mbegu za miti. Keki maarufu mara nyingi zinafanana vizuri na kikombe cha kahawa yenye chachu.

translations.source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.reference: Ikiwa unataka vitumbua vidogo ingawa bora, jaribu kile ambacho kutegemea eneo kinaitwa Berliner, Pfannkuchen au Krapfen.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa unataka magodoro ndogo lakini laduni, jaribu aina za magodoro ambazo hufanyika katika maeneo tofauti, kama vile Berliner, Pfannkuchen, au Krapfen.

translations.source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.reference: Bizari ni chakula kilichoundwa kwa mimea na viungo, pamoja na nyama au mboga.
translations.hypothesis: Chutney ni aina ya chakula ambayo hutayarishwa kwa kutumia viungo na mchanganyiko wa vyakula, pamoja na nyama au mboga.

translations.source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.reference: Bizari inaweza kuwa "kavu" au "yenye unyevunyevu" kulingana na kiasi cha kioevu.
translations.hypothesis: Supu inaweza kuwa "ya kavu" au "ya maji", kulingana na kiwango cha maji.

translations.source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.reference: katika maeneo ya bara la Kaskazini mwa India na Pakistani, mtindi kwa kawaida hutumiwa katika mchuzi wenye viungo; Katika Kusini mwa India na mikoa mingine ya pwani ya bara ndogo, maziwa ya nazi hutumiwa sana.
translations.hypothesis: Katika eneo la ndani la India na Pakistan, يتم استعمال لبن kwa kawaida katika vyaji; katika India ya Kusini na baadhi ya eneo la pwani la eneo hilo, يتم استعمال حليب جوز.

translations.source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.reference: Kukiwa na visiwa 17,000 vya kuchagua, chakula cha Indonesia ni jina la kijumla linalosimamia aina kubwa ya vyakula vinavyopatikana kote nchini.
translations.hypothesis: Pamoja na kisiwa 17,000 za kuchagua, chakula cha Indonesia ni mrefu ambao una jumuisha aina kubwa za vyaji vya kimaeneo vinapatikana katika nchi nzima.

translations.source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.reference: Lakini, llikitumiwa bila vivumishi zaidi, neno hilo huelekea kumaanisha chakula ambacho mwanzoni kilitoka sehemu za kati na mashariki mwa kisiwa kikuu cha Java.
translations.hypothesis: Lakini, ikiwa hutumiwa bila maelezo zaidi, neno hili huwa linamaanisha chakula ambalo lina asili kutoka katika sehemu kuu na mashariki za kisiwa kuu la Java.

translations.source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.reference: Chakula kinachopatikana sana katika maeneo mapana ya funguvisiwa, ni vyakula vya Kijavanese vilivyotayarishwa kwa ustadi sahili, ladha yake ya kimsingi ikiwa ni njugu karanga, pilipili, sukari (hususan sukari ya nazi ya Javanese) na viungo tofauti vinavyonukia.
translations.hypothesis: Hivi sasa, vyakula vya Javan na aina mbalimbali, ambazo zina matumizi ya viungo rahisi, zinapatikana katika eneo lote la kisiwa, na ladha kuu ambazo watu wa Javan wanapenda ni mbaazi, pilipili, sukari (hasa sukari ya kokos ya Javan), na aina mbalimbali za viungo vya harufu.

translations.source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.reference: Vikuku ni nguzo zinazoshikilia miguu ya mwendeshaji ambazo huning’inia chini katika pande zote mbili za matandiko.
translations.hypothesis: "Mshale ni msaada wa miguu za farasi, ambapo yana kupanda pande za jokero."

translations.source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.reference: Zinampa mpanda farasi utulivu mkubwa lakini zinaweza kuwa na wasiwasi wa kiusalama kwa sababu ya uwezo wa miguu ya mpanda farasi kukwama ndani yake.
translations.hypothesis: Hizi hutoa usalama kubwa kwa mtumiaji, lakini zinaweza kusababisha matatizo, kama vile hatari, ikiwa viwe na uwezekano wa mshona kupata majirani.

translations.source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.reference: Ikiwa mwendeshaji farasi atatupwa kuotka kwa farasi lakini mguu wake ufungiwe kwenye tandiko, wanaweza kukokotwa ikiwa farasi atatoroka. Ili kupunguza hatari hii, hatua kadhaa za usalama zinaweza kuchukuliwa.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa jockeys anarukwa kutoka kwenye mbwa lakini ana mguu amefungwa kwenye kamba, anaweza kufungwa ikiwa mbwa hufuga. Ili kupunguza hatari hii, kuna hatua kadhaa za usalama zinazoweza kuchukuliwa.

translations.source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.reference: Kwanza, waendeshaji wengi huvaa kiatu cha buti kilicho juu na laini, chembamba kabisa, soli.
translations.hypothesis: Kwanza, karibu watoaji, huwa na viatu maalumu za kuendesha, ambazo zina pete na подош (sole) laini, ambayo ni ndogo.

translations.source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.reference: Kisha, matandiko mengine, hasa matandiko ya Kiingereza yana fito za kiusalama ambzo huruhusu ngozi ya kuvutwa kuangukia tandiko kama kama itavutwa nyuma na mpanda farasi anayeanguka.
translations.hypothesis: Zaidi, baadhi ya recha, haswa recha za aina ya Kijerumani, zina bar za usalama ambazo huruhusu ngozi ya recha kukojoa kutoka kwenye recha ikiwa raka amepotea.

translations.source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.reference: Bonde la Cochamo – eneo kuu la makusudio ya ukweaji nchini Chile, lijulikanalo kama Yosemite ya Marekani Kusini, na kuta kubwa anuwai za matale na majabali.
translations.hypothesis: Mbuga ya Cochamó - Kanda kuu ya kii katika Chile, inayojulikana kama "Yosemite" ya Amerika الجنوبية, na urefu wa kubwa na mitaa za kii za graniti.

translations.source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.reference: Mikutano huwa na mandhari za kusisimua kutoka vileleni. Wapanda mlima kutoka pande zote za ulimwengu wanaendelea kuanzisha njia mpya kati ya uwezo wake wa kuta.
translations.hypothesis: Mlima una maeneo yenye mandhari za ajabu. Wanamaji kutoka kote ulimwenguni wanaendelea kuandaa njia mpya katika eneo lake lenye uwezo usio na mwisho.

translations.source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.reference: Michezo ya theluji ya kuteremka, ambayo ni pamoja na mchezo wa kuteleza juu ya theluji na mchezo wa kupanda theluji, ni michezo maarufu inayohusisha kuteleza chini ya ardhi iliyofunikwa na theluji kwa ubaos au bao za theluji zilizofungiwa kwenye miguu yako.
translations.hypothesis: Michezo ya kupanda kwenye shida, ambayo ni pamoja na skiing na snowboarding, ni michezo maarufu ambapo unaendesha kwenye eneo lenye shida kwa kutumia ski au deski, ambazo zinaambatishwa kwenye miguu zako.

translations.source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.reference: Kuteleza juu ya theluji ni shughuli kubwa huku washiriki wengi, ambao mara kwa mara hujulikana kama "ski bums," wakipanga likizo nzima kwa kuteleza juu ya theluji katika eneo fulani.
translations.hypothesis: 스키इंग ni shughuli kubwa ya kusafiri ambayo ina watoaji wengi, na wakati mwingine huitwa "watoaji wa skii," ambao mara nyingi, watalia safari nzima kulingana na skii katika eneo fulani.

translations.source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.reference: Wazo la uendeshaji ubao kwenye theluji ni la zamani sana - michoro ya pango inaonyesha waendeshaji wa ubao kwenye theluji wa miaka ya zamani ya hadi 5000 KK!
translations.hypothesis: Fikra ya kukimbia kwenye mbegu ni ya zamani sana – picha za ndani ambazo zinaonyesha watu wanaokimbia kwenye mbegu zinaanzia hadi mwaka 5000 BC!

translations.source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.reference: Mchezo wa kuteleza kwa kasi kwenye mteremko wenye theluji ulianza angalau karne ya 17, na mnamo 1861 kilabu cha kwanza cha burudani cha utelezaji kwenye barafu kilifunguliwa na watu wa Norwegi huko Australia.
translations.hypothesis: 스키, kama mchezo, limekuwa na historia tangu karne ya 17, na mwaka wa 1861, klabu ya kwanza ya ndege ilifunguliwa na Wnorweg katika Australia.

translations.source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.reference: Kuteleza kwa kubeba shanta: Shughuli hii pia huitwa kuteleza mashambani, kutalii kwa kuteleza au matembezi ya kuteleza.
translations.hypothesis: Saha za kupanda kwenye bundi: Hii pia inaitwa "kupanda kwenye bundi", "saha za kupanda kwenye bundi", au "saha za kupanda kwenye bundi".

translations.source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.reference: Inahusiana na lakini kawaida haishirikiani na ziara za utelezaji kwenye theluji ya milima mirefu au upandaji wa milima, hilo la mwisho hufanywa katika eneo lenye mteremko na linahitaji bao na buti ngumu.
translations.hypothesis: Hili ni aina ya ndege ambayo ni sawa na, lakini kwa kawaida si pamoja na, ndege za kibiashara au kupanda, ambazo hufanyika kwenye mlima na zinahitaji skidi na viatu ambavyo ni imara zaidi.

translations.source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.reference: Fikiria kuhusu njia ya utelezaji kwa theluji kama njia mfanano ya kukwea.
translations.hypothesis: Fikiria njia ya skiing kama njia sawa ya kupanda.

translations.source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.reference: Katika hali nzuri utaweza kufikia umbali mkubwa kiasi kuliko kutembea – lakini ni mara chache sana utapata kasi za kuteleza sehemu za mashambani bila shanta nzito katika njia zilizopitiwa awali.
translations.hypothesis: Katika hali nzuri, utaweza kusafiri umbali zaidi kuliko kutumia miguu – lakini, kwa kawaida, hautapata kasi sawa na mbia, bila rucksack kubwa, kwenye njia zilizopangwa.

translations.source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.reference: Uropa ni bara ambalo ni dogo kiasi lakini lina nchi nyingi huru. Katika hali ya kawaida, kusafiri kupitia nchi nyingi kungemaanisha kulazimika kufanya maombi ya visa na udhibiti wa pasipoti mara nyingi.
translations.hypothesis: Ulaya ni eneo ambalo ni ndogo, lakini lina nchi nyingi zinazofanya kazi kwa hiari. Katika hali za kawaida, kusafiri kupitia nchi nyingi kunamaanisha kuwa lazima uandike maombi ya visa na uendesha utaratibu wa pasipoti mara nyingi.

translations.source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.reference: Eneo la Schengen, hata hivyo, hufanya kazi kiasi kama nchi moja kuhusiana na jambo hili.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, eneo la Schengen kinaendesha kwa njia ambayo inaweza kulingana na eneo la moja katika suala hili.

translations.source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.reference: Bora ubakie katika eneo hili, unaweza kuvuka mipaka bila kupitia maeneo ya ukaguzi wa pasipoti tena.
translations.hypothesis: Muda tu unapokuwa katika eneo hili, unaweza kwa kawaida kuvuka mipaka bila kuendesha tena hatua za utambuzi.

translations.source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.reference: Vilevile, kwa kuwa na visa ya Schengen, huhitaji kutoa maombi ya visa kwa kila nchi iliyo memba wa Schengen kivyake, hivyo kuokoa muda, pesa na nyaraka.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, kwa kuwa na visa la Schengen, huna haja ya kuomba visa kwa kila nchi mwanachama ya Schengen, hivyo kuokoa wakati, pesa, na madokumenta.

translations.source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.reference: Hakuna ufafanuzi wa kijumla kuhusu ni bidhaa zipi za viwandani ni za kale. Baadhi ya mashirika ya ushuru hufafanua bidhaa zenye zaidi ya miaka 100 kuwa za kale.
translations.hypothesis: Hakuwepo maelezo ya kawaida kuhusu bidhaa za viwandani ambazo ni "bidhaa za kale". Baadhi ya taasisi za ushuru zina maelezo kwamba bidhaa za zaidi ya miaka 100 ni bidhaa za kale.

translations.source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.reference: Ufafanuzi una tofauti za kijiografia, ambapo kikomo cha umri kinaweza kuwa kifupi katika maeneo kama Marekani ya Kaskazini kuliko Ulaya.
translations.hypothesis: Maana hii ina tofauti za zaeneo, ambapo umri wa kawaida unaweza kuwa mfupi katika maeneo kama vile Amerika ya Kaskazini, ikilinganishwa na Ulaya.

translations.source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.reference: Bidhaa za sanaa zinaweza kufafanuliwa kama bidhaa za kale, ingawa ni changa kuliko bidhaa sawa zinazotengenezwa kwa wingi.
translations.hypothesis: Bidhaa za sanaa zinaweza kufafanuliwa kama vitu vya kale, ingawa ni vya hivi majuzi zaidi kuliko bidhaa za kawaida.

translations.source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.reference: Ukulima wa kulungu aktiki ni riziki muhimu miongoni mwa watu wa Sámi na utamaduni unaozunguka biashara hiyo ni muhimu pia kwa wengi walio na taaluma nyingine.
translations.hypothesis: Upandaji ng'ombe za aina ya reindeer ni njia muhimu ya upatikanaji ya ajira kwa Wasaami, na utamaduni unaoambatana na shughuli hii pia ni muhimu kwa watu wengine wenye kazi tofauti.

translations.source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo tangu jadi, sio Sami wote wamekuwa wakijihusisha na ufugaji mkubwa wa kulungu aktiki, lakini waliishi kutoka kwa uvuvi, uwindaji na nyingine kama hizo, na kufuga kulungu aktiki sana sana kama wanyama wa kufanya kazi.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, katika utamaduni, si wote wa Sami walishiriki katika kilimo kikubwa cha ng'ombe, lakini walishinda maisha kupitia uvuvi, uhuni, na shughuli nyingine, na ng'ombe walikuwa kama wanyama wa kufanya kazi.

translations.source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.reference: Leo Wasámi wengi hufanya kazi katika biashara za kisasa. Utalii ni wa mapato muhimu katika Sápmi, eneo la Sámi.
translations.hypothesis: Leo, watu wengi wa Sami wanafanya kazi katika sekta za kisasa. Utalii ni mapato muhimu katika eneo la Sami.

translations.source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.reference: Ingawa inatumika sana, na hususana miongoni mwa watu wasio Waromani, neno "Jipsi" mara nyingi huchukuliwa kama la kukera kwa sababu linahusishwa na ubaguzi hasi na mitazamo isiyo sahihi ya watu wa Romani.
translations.hypothesis: Licha ya kwamba hutumiwa sana, hasa miongoni mwa watu ambao si wa Roma, neno "Gypsy" mara nyingi linazingatiwa kama la kibaguzi kwa sababu la uhusiano lake na aina za maoni hasi na uelewa usio sahihi kuhusu watu wa Roma.

translations.source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.reference: Kama nchi utakayozuru itakua ni somo kwa ushauri wa kusafiri, bima ya afya yako au bima ya kufuta usafiri wako huenda ikaathirika.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa nchi ambayo utaenda humo inakuwa chini ya tahari za usafiri, bima yako ya afya ya safari au bima yako ya kufuta safari inaweza kutathminiwa.

translations.source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.reference: Pia pengine ungetaka kushauriana na ushauri wa serikali bali na yako, lakini ushauri wao umeundiwa raia wao.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, unaweza kuomba ushauri kutoka kwa serikali zingine, lakini ushauri huo ni kwa raia wa serikali hiyo.

translations.source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.reference: Kama mfano mmoja, raia wa Marekani katika Mashariki ya Kati huenda wakakumbwa na hali tofauti kutoka kwa Wazungu na Waarabu.
translations.hypothesis: Kama mfano, raia wa Marekani katika Mashariki ya kati, wanaweza kukabiliana na hali tofauti ikilinganishwa na raia wa Uropa au Wahindi.

translations.source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.reference: Ushauri ni muhtasari mfupi tu wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi moja.
translations.hypothesis: Taarifa ni muhtasari mfupi wa hali ya kisiasa katika nchi moja.

translations.source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.reference: Maoni yanayowasilishwa mara nyingi huwa ni ya haraka, ya kijumla na yaliyosahilishwa sana yakilinganishwa na habari za kina zinazopatikana kwingineko.
translations.hypothesis: Maoni yaliyotolewa mara nyingi ni ya msingi, kiujumla, na yanapunguzwa, ikilinganishwa na taarifa zaidi zinazopatikana mahali pengine.

translations.source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.reference: Hali kali ya hewa ni neno la kawaida kwa hali yoyote hatari ya hali ya hewa na ina uwezo wa kusababisha uharibifu, usumbufu mkubwa wa kijamii, au kupotea kwa maisha ya mwanadamu.
translations.hypothesis: Hali hatari ni neno la kawaida linalotumika kwa hali yoyote hatari ambayo ina uwezekano wa kusababisha uharibifu, mabadiliko makubwa katika jamii, au upotezaji wa maisha wa binadamu.

translations.source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Hali kali ya hewa inawezakuwa popote duniani, na kuna aina nyingi ambazo zinaweza kutegemea jiografia, sura ya nchi, na hali ya anga.
translations.hypothesis: Tabia za hewa kali zinaweza kutokea popote ulimwenguni, na kuna aina tofauti, ambazo zinaweza kutegemea eneo, mazingira, na hali ya hewa.

translations.source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.reference: Upepo mkubwa,mvua ya mawe, ukaukaji, na mioto ya msitu ni maumbo na athari za hali kali za hewa, vilevile dhoruba, , tufani, mifereji ya maji na vimbunga.
translations.hypothesis: Upepo mkali, amani, mvua nyingi, na moto, ni aina na matokeo ya hali mbaya, sawa na aina za hali kama vile aina, tornados, miti, na siklon.

translations.source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.reference: Matukio ya hali kali ya hewa ya kieneo na kimsimu yanatia ndani dhoruba kali za theluji, dhoruba za theluji, dhoruba za barafu, na dhoruba za vumbi.
translations.hypothesis: ظواهر ya hewa hatari za eneo na za msimu, pamoja na hali ya theluji, hali ya theluji, hali ya theluji, na hali ya vumbi.

translations.source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.reference: Wasafiri wanashauriwa kwa dhati kujua kuhusu hatari yoyote ya anga mbaya inayoathiri eneo lao kwani huenda ikaathiri mipango yoyote ya usafiri.
translations.hypothesis: Watalii wanahimizwa sana kuwa na ufahamu kuhusu hatari yoyote inayoweza kutokea katika eneo lao, kwani inaweza kuathiri mipango yao ya kusafiri.

translations.source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.reference: Mtu yeyote anayepanga kutembelea nchi ambayo inazingatiwa kuwa eneo la vita anapaswa kupata mafunzo ya kitaalamu.
translations.hypothesis: Mwalimu yeyote anayopanga ziara katika nchi ambayo inaweza kuwa eneo la vita, anapaswa kupata mafunzo rasmi.

translations.source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.reference: Utafutaji wa ‘Kozi ya mazingira yenye uhasama’ kwenye Intaneti huenda pengine ukatoa anwani ya kampuni ya kienyeji.
translations.hypothesis: Utafutaji kwenye mtandao kwa "kozi ya mazingira hatari" unaweza kutoa anwani ya kampuni ya eneo.

translations.source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.reference: Kwa kawaida kozi itashughulikia masuala yote yaliyojadiliwa hapa kwa kina, na aghalabu pamoja na uzoefu wa moja kwa moja.
translations.hypothesis: Korso kawaida hufunika masuala yote yaliyotajwa hapa kwa kina zaidi, na kwa kawaida pamoja na uzoefu wa vitendo.

translations.source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.reference: Kwa kawaida kozi itachukua siku 2-5 na itahusisha uigizaji, huduma nyingi za kwanza na wakati mwingine mafunzo ya kutumia silaha.
translations.hypothesis: Kumbwa, kozi hiyo itakuwa kutoka siku 2 hadi 5, na itajumuisha matumizi ya vitendo, usaidizi wa kwanza, na wakati mwingine pia mafunzo kuhusu silaha.

translations.source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.reference: Vitabu na majarida yanayozungumzia maisha ya nyikani ni ya kawaida, lakini machapisho yanayohusiana na maeneo ya vita ni machache.
translations.hypothesis: Vitabu na majarida zinazohusu kuishi katika pori ni nyingi, lakini vitabu na majarida zinazohusu eneo za vita ni nadra.

translations.source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.reference: Wasafiri wanaonuia kwenda ng'ambo kwa upasuaji wa kijinsia lazima wahakikishe kuwa wamebeba stakabadhi halali kwa sababu ya safari ya kurudi.
translations.hypothesis: Watu ambao wanapanga upasuaji wa kubadilisha jinsia nje ya nchi, lazima dhahiri kuwa na hati za kweli za safari ya kurudi.

translations.source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.reference: Utayari wa serikali kutoa pasipoti zisizotaja jinsia (X) au hati zilizosasishwa ili kulingana na jina na jinsia inayonuiwa unatofautiana.
translations.hypothesis: Kuthibitisha na serikali kuendelea kuwapa pasiposti bila taarifa za jinsia (X) au hati ambazo zimebadilishwa ili kuendana na jina na jinsia inayotaka, kuna tofauti.

translations.source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.reference: Utayari wa serikali za kigeni kukubali nyaraka hizi unatofautiana vilevile.
translations.hypothesis: Nuru ya vyama vya serikali za kigeni kutimiza makubaliano hizi ni sawa na tofauti.

translations.source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.reference: Utafutaji katika vituo vya ukaguzi wa kiusalama pia umekuwa wenye uingiliaji zaidi katika enzi za baada ya Septemba 11, 2001.
translations.hypothesis: Uchunguzi katika hatua za usalama pia zimekuwa zaidi ya hatari baada ya 11 Septemba, 2001.

translations.source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.reference: Wasenge hawafai kutarajia kupitia kwenye kiwambo cha uchunguzi na watoke huko ikiwa utu na siri zao ziko kamilifu.
translations.hypothesis: Watu wanaotumia huduma za matibabu kabla ya upasuaji, haipaswi kutarajia kuwa na faragha na heshima zao wakati wa kupitia skaner.

translations.source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.reference: Mikondo ya mawimbi ya maji ni yale yanayorudi kutokwa kwa mawimbi yanayoachana ufukoni, aghalabu mwambani au mahali sawa.
translations.hypothesis: Tezi za maji ni mzunguko wa maji ambapo maji hutoka baada ya alama, mara nyingi karibu na tezi au eneo la kulingana.

translations.source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.reference: Kwa sababu ya topolojia ya chini ya maji, yale yanayorudi huwa yamelimbikizia katika maeneo machache ya kina, na mawimbi ya kasi kwa maji ya kina yanaweza kuundika hapo.
translations.hypothesis: Kutokana na usanifu wa chini, mzunguko wa maji unaoendelea unaoenea katika sehemu kadhaa za kina, na kunaweza kuunda sasa kubwa kwenda kwenye maji ya kina.

translations.source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.reference: Vifo vingi hutokea kutokana na machovu ya kujaribu kuogelea kinyume na mawimbi, hali ambayo huenda ikawa ngumu.
translations.hypothesis: Kifo nyingi hutokea kutokana na uchovu, wakati wa kujaribu kurudi kwenye mto, ambapo huenda haziwezekani.

translations.source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.reference: Mara tu utakapotoka kwenye mkondo, kuogelea kurudi si kugumu zaidi ya kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: Mara tu unapokojoa, kuogelea tena si vigumu zaidi kuliko kawaida.

translations.source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.reference: Jaribu kulenga mahali ambapo hutashikwa tena au, kulingana na ujuzi wako au kama umeonekana, huenda ukataka kungoja uokovu.
translations.hypothesis: Jaribu kuwekea lengo mahali ambapo hautakutwa tena, au, kulingana na ujuzi wako na ikiwa wamekutambua, unaweza kuamua kusubiri msaada.

translations.source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.reference: Mshtuko wa kurudi tena huja upesi kuliko mshtuko wa tamaduni (kuna kipindi chini ya fungate), hukaa kwa muda mrefu, na huweza kuwa kali zaidi.
translations.hypothesis: Mgambo wa kurudi nyumbani huja mapema kuliko mgambo wa mabadiliko za utamaduni (hakuna kipindi cha "furaha"), una muda mrefu, na unaweza kuwa kubwa zaidi.

translations.source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.reference: Wasafiri ambao walikuwa na wakati rahisi kuzoea utamaduni mpya wakati mwingine wana wakati mgumu wa kurekebisha upya utamaduni wao wa asili.
translations.hypothesis: Watalii ambao walipata uzoefu rahisi katika kuadapt kwa utamaduni mpya, wakati mwingine wana matatizo kubwa zaidi katika kurudi kwenye utamaduni wao wa asili.

translations.source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.reference: Wakati wa kurudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi ughaibuni, umezoea utamaduni mpya na kupoteza baadhi ya tabia zako kutoka kwa utamaduni wako wa nyumbani.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati wa kurudi nyumbani baada ya kuishi njeru, umepata majeshi na umepoteza baadhi ya tabia zako kutoka kwa utamaduni wa nyumbani.

translations.source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.reference: Wakati ulienda ng’ambo kwa mara ya kwanza, watu walikuwa pengine na subira na kuelewa, wakijua wasafiri katika nchi ya kigeni, wanahitaji kuzoea.
translations.hypothesis: Wakati ulipoenda njerumani, watu walikuwa na uvumilivu na uelewa, wakijua kwamba watu wanaosafiri nchi mpya wanahitaji kuajiriwa.

translations.source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.reference: Huenda watu wasitarajie kwamba uvumilivu na ufahamu pia ni muhimu kwa wasafiri wanaorudi nyumbani.
translations.hypothesis: Watu hawawezi kutarajia kwamba uvumilivu na uelewa pia ni muhimu kwa watalii wanaorudi nyumbani.

translations.source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.reference: Sauti ya piramidi na onyesho la nuru ni mojawapo ya mambo yanayofurahisha zaidi katika eneo la watoto.
translations.hypothesis: Maonyesho ya sauti na mwanga ya piramidi ni moja ya vitu vya kupendeza zaidi katika eneo hilo kwa watoto.

translations.source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.reference: Unaweza kuona piramidi gizani na unaweza kuziona katika utulivu kabla ya maonyesho kuanza.
translations.hypothesis: Unaweza kuona misemo katika giza, na unaweza kuona pia katika utulivu kabla ya tamasha kuanza.

translations.source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.reference: Kwa kawaida huwa unasikia sauti ya watalii na wauzaji. Hadithi ya sauti na mwanga ni kama kitabu cha hadithi.
translations.hypothesis: Kawaida, una kusikia sauti za watalii na wafanyabiashara. Hadithi kuhusu sauti na mwanga ni sawa na hadithi.

translations.source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.reference: Sphinx amewekwa kama usuli na msimulizi wa hadithi ndefu.
translations.hypothesis: Sphinx ni sehemu muhimu, na pia ni mwandishi wa hadithi fupi.

translations.source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.reference: Matuko yanaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi na piramidi tofauti huangaza.
translations.hypothesis: Picha zinaonyeshwa kwenye piramidi, na piramidi tofauti zinaangaziwa.

translations.source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.reference: Visiwa vya kusini mwa Shetlandi, vilivyogunduliwa mnamo 1819, vinadaiwa kuwa milki ya mataifa kadhaa na vina misingi mingi, ikiwemo kumi na sita iliyo hai mnamo 2020.
translations.hypothesis: Visiwa vya South Shetland, ambavyo viliiguliwa mwaka 1819, vimeiguliwa na mataifa kadhaa na zina makao mengi, na mwaka 2020, makao yenye matumizi yanakuwa 16.

translations.source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: Visiwa vimo kilomita 120 kaskazini mwa Rasi. Kubwa zaidi ni Kisiwa cha King George kilicho na makazi ya Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: Shughuli hii iko kilomita 120 kaskazini mwa Mlima. Shughuli kubwa zaidi ni Kisiwa cha King George, na eneo la makazi la Villa Las Estrellas.

translations.source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.reference: Vingine ni pamoja na Kisiwa cha Livingston, na Udanganyifu, ambapo kaldera iliyofurika ya volkano hai hutoa bandari asili ya kipekee.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya hizi ni Kisiwa la Livingston, na Deception, ambapo kabati iliyojaa maji la volcano linaloendelea kuwaka, hutoa bandari ya asili nzuri.

translations.source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.reference: Ellsworth Land ni mkoa kusini mwa Peninsula, unaopakana na Bahari la Bellingshausen.
translations.hypothesis: Mkoa wa Ellsworth unaenea kaskazini mwa peninsula, na unazunguka bahari ya Bellingshausen.

translations.source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.reference: Milima ya Peninsula hapa inajiunga na huu uwanda, kisha ikaibuka tena kuunda safu ya kilomita 360 ya Milima ya Ellsworth, na kugawanywa na Tungamo za barafu za Minnesota.
translations.hypothesis: Nguzo za eneo hili zinaungana na eneo pito, na kisha zinaonekana tena ili kujenga sura ya kilomita 360 ya mlima Ellsworth, ambayo imegawanywa na barafu la Minnesota.

translations.source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.reference: Sehemu ya kaskazini au msafa wa Sentinel una milima mirefu zaidi ya Antaktika kama vile Vinson Massif, iliyofikia urefu wa 4892 na Mlima Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: Bahari ya kaskazini au Safu ya Sentinel ina milima ya juu zaidi katika Antartika, ambayo ni Vinson Massif, ambapo kilele ni mlima Vinson, na urefu wa 4892 m.

translations.source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.reference: Katika sehemu za mbali, bila signali za simu za mkononi, simu ya setilaiti huenda ikawa chaguo lako la pekee.
translations.hypothesis: Katika maeneo gumu, ambapo hakuna huduma ya simu, simu ya satelaiti inaweza kuwa chaguo lako pekee.

translations.source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.reference: Simu ya satelaiti sio kwa ujumla mbadala wa simu ya rununu, kwani lazima uwe nje wazi na kuona laini za satelaiti ili kupiga simu.
translations.hypothesis: Simu ya satelaiti si mara nyingi njia ya kubadili simu ya rununu, kwani lazima uwe nje na uone moja kwa moja kwenye satelaiti ili kuweza kupeleka simu.

translations.source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.reference: Huduma hutumika mara kwa mara na usafirishaji, vikiwemo vyombo vya anasa, vilevile safari zilizo na mahitaji ya data na sauti ya mbali.
translations.hypothesis: Huduma hii hutumiwa mara nyingi na usafirishaji, pamoja na vyombo vya burudani, na pia kwa majaribio ambapo kuna haja ya data na mawasiliano.

translations.source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.reference: Mtoaji wako wa huduma za simu anastahili aweze kutoa habari zaidi kuhusu kuunganishwa na huduma hii.
translations.hypothesis: Mtoa huduma wa simu wa eneo lako anaweza kutoa maelezo zaidi kuhusu jinsi ya kujiunga na huduma hii.

translations.source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.reference: Uchaguzi unaozidi kuwa maarufu kwa wale wanaopanga pengo la mwaka mmoja ni kusafiri na kujifunza.
translations.hypothesis: Moja ya chaguo zinazopopulika zaidi kwa wale ambao wanafanya mpango wa "siku za mapumziko" ni kusafiri na kujifunza.

translations.source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.reference: Hii haswa ni maarufu kwa waliohitimu shuleni, ikiwaruhusu kukaa nje kwa mwaka mmoja kabla ya kuingia chuo kikuu, bila kuathiri masomo yao.
translations.hypothesis: Hii ni njia maarufu, hasa kwa wanafunzi waliomaliza shule, na inawapa fursa ya kuchukua mwaka mmoja wa mapumziko kabla ya kuanza kozi ya chuo, bila kuathiri elimu yao.

translations.source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.reference: Katika hali nyingi, kujisajilisha kwa kozi mwaka-pengo ughaibuni kwa hakika kunaweza kuboresha nafasi zako za kuendeleza elimu ya juu katika nchi yako.
translations.hypothesis: Katika kesi nyingi, kujiandikisha katika kozi ya mwaka wa kupunguza, nje ya nchi, inaweza kweli kuboresha nafasi zako za kuendelea na masomo ya juu katika nchi yako.

translations.source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.reference: Kwa kawaida kutakuwa na ada ya mafunzo ili kujisajili katika mipango hii ya kielimu.
translations.hypothesis: Kawaida, kuna ada ya usajili kwa kozi hizi za elimu.

translations.source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.reference: Ufini ni mahali pazuri pa uendeshaji mashua. “Nchi ya maziwa elfu” ina maelfu ya visiwa pia, katika maziwa na katika visiwa vya pwani.
translations.hypothesis: Finland ni destinasheni nzuri kwa sheria. "Nchi ya mitaani elfu" pia ina mitaani elfu, katika mitaani na katika mitaani ya pwani.

translations.source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.reference: Kwa funguvisiwa na visiwa sio lazima uhitaji meli.
translations.hypothesis: Katika madao na maji, si lazima kuwa na boti.

translations.source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.reference: Ingawa visiwa vya pwani na maziwa makubwa zaidi kwa kweli ni makubwa kutosha kwa mashua yoyote, boti ndogo ama hata kayaki hutoa uzoefu tofauti.
translations.hypothesis: Licha ya kwamba madao na maji kubwa ni vya kutosha kwa vyombo vyote, boti ndogo au hata kano hutoa uzoefu tofauti.

translations.source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.reference: Kuendesha mashua ni mchezo wa kimataifa nchini Finland, na mashua kwa kila watu saba au nane.
translations.hypothesis: Uzoefu wa kukimbia barabara ni shughuli ya kitaifa nchini Finland, ambapo kuna boti kwa kila watu saba au nane.

translations.source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.reference: Hii inaendana na Norway, Sweden na Nyuzilandi, lakini vinginevyo ni tofauti kabisa (kwa mfano katika Uholanzi takwimu ni moja kwa arobaini).
translations.hypothesis: Hii ni sawa na Norway, Sweden na New Zealand, lakini kwa ujumla ni ya kipekee (kwa mfano, nchini Netherlands, idadi hii ni kutoka moja hadi ishirini).

translations.source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Nyingi ya safari za Baltic huwa na kukaa kwa muda mrefu katika St. Petersburg, Urusi.
translations.hypothesis: Kama kawaida, safari nyingi za Baltiki zinaweza kujumuisha kukaa kwa muda mrefu katika mji wa St. Petersburg, Urusi.

translations.source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.reference: Hii ina maana kuwa unaweza kulitembelea jiji la kihistoria kwa kutwa kadhaa huku ukirudi na kulala kwenye meli wakati wa usiku.
translations.hypothesis: Hii inamaanisha kwamba unaweza kutembelea jiji hilo la kihistoria kwa siku mbili, na kuondoka na kuishi kwenye meli usiku.

translations.source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.reference: Ikiwa huwa unaenda ufukweni tu ukitumia safari za meli hutahitaji visa tofauti (kufikia mwaka wa 2009).
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa utamaliza safari yako kwenye kisiwa kupitia safari za meli, hautahitaji visa tofauti (kwa mujibu wa mwaka wa 2009).

translations.source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.reference: Baadhi ya safari za baharini huonyesha Berlin na Ujerumani katika brosha zao. Kama unavyoona katika ramani iliyo hapo juu, Berlin haipo popote karibu na bahari na safari ya jiji hili haijumuishwi katika bei ya safari za baharini.
translations.hypothesis: Baadhi ya safari za baharini zinaorodho Berlin, Ujerumani katika hati za matangulizi. Kama unawezaona kwenye ramani, Berlin si karibu na bahari, na ziara ya jiji hiyo si pamoja na bei ya safari.

translations.source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.reference: Kusafiri kwa ndege kunaweza kuwa uzoefu wa kuogofya kwa watu wa umri na malezi yote, hasa kama hawajasafiri kwa ndege tena au walipatwa na tukio la kufadhaisha.
translations.hypothesis: Kutumia ndege inaweza kuwa uzoefu wa kutisha kwa watu wa kila umri na asili, haswa ikiwa wamehama hapo awali au wamepitia tukio hatari.

translations.source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.reference: Si jambo la kuaibikia: si tofauti sana na hofu ya kibinafsi na isiyopenda vitu vingine ambayo watu wengi wako nayo.
translations.hypothesis: Hii si jambo la kujivunia, wala si tofauti na hofu na mapendeleo ya kibinafsi ambazo watu wengi wana.

translations.source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.reference: Kwa wengine, kuelewa jinsi ndege inavyofanya kazi na kinachotokea wakati wa ndege kuruka inaweza kusaidia kushinda hofu ambayo msingi wake ni mambo yasiyojulikana ama kutokuwa kwenye udhibiti.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa baadhi, kujua zaidi kuhusu jinsi ndege hutumia na kile ambacho hutokea wakati wa ndege, inaweza kusaidia kupunguza chanya ambalo limejazwa na ujasiri au kutokuwa na udhibiti.

translations.source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.reference: Kampuni za uchukuzi hulipwa vizuri kwa kufikisha vitu haraka. Mara kwa mara, muda ni muhimu sana kwa hati za kibiashara, bidhaa, au vipuli kwa ukarabati wa haraka.
translations.hypothesis: Kampuni za usafirishaji hushajiwa vizuri kwa kusafirisha vitu haraka. Kawaida, wakati ni muhimu sana, hasa katika hati za biashara, bidhaa, au vitu vya ukarabati wa haraka.

translations.source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.reference: Katika baadhi ya njia, kampuni kubwa zina ndege zao wenyewe, lakini kwa njia nyingine na kampuni ndogo kulikuwa na shida.
translations.hypothesis: Katika njia fulani, kampuni kubwa zina ndege zao, lakini kwa njia nyingine na kampuni ndogo, ilikuwa kuna tatizo.

translations.source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.reference: Kama wangetuma vitu kwa mizigo ya ndege, katika baadhi ya njia huenda ingechukua siku kadhaa kukamilisha upakuaji na forodha.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa zimetumia usafiri wa anga, katika baadhi ya njia, kulikuwa na wakati wa siku kupitia mchakato wa kupakia na utaratibu.

translations.source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.reference: Njia pekee ya kuipitisha kwa haraka ilikuwa kuituma kama mzigo uliokaguliwa. Kanuni za kampuni za ndege hazitazikubalia kutuma mzigo bila abiria, ambapo ndipo unaingilia.
translations.hypothesis: njia pekee ya kupata bidhaa hiyo haraka ilikuwa kupitua kama mizigo. Sheria za kampuni ya ndege haziruhusu kupeleka mizigo bila mteja, na ndipo ambapo wewe unaingia.

translations.source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.reference: Njia dhahiri ya kusafiri katika daraja la kwanza au kibiashara ni kutoa pesa nyingi kwa fursa hiyo (au, bora zaidi, kufanya kampuni yako ikulipie).
translations.hypothesis: Njia rahisi ya kusafiri katika darasa la kwanza au biashara ni kulipa ada kubwa, lakini (au, bora zaidi,omba kampuni yako ifanye hivyo).

translations.source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.reference: Walakini, hii haikuji kwa bei rahisi: kwa sababu ya sheria mbaya zisizobainika, unaweza kutarajia kulipa hadi mara nne ya kawaida ya uchumi, nauli ya biashara, na mara 11 kwa cheo cha kwanza!
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, hii si ghali: kama kanuni za jumla, unaweza kutarajia kulipa hadi mara minne ya bei ya kawaida ya safari ya kazi, na mara elfu moja kwa safari ya kwanza!

translations.source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.reference: Kuongea kwa jumla, hakuna haja ya hata kutafuta vipunguzo kwa biashara au viti vya daraja la kwanza katika safari za ndege za moja kwa moja toka A hadi B.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa ujumla, hakuna faida ya kutafuta punguzo kwa viti za biashara au vya kwanza kwenye ndege za moja kwa moja kutoka A hadi B.

translations.source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.reference: Kampuni za ndege zinajua vizuri kwamba kuna kundi fulani la ndani la wasafiri ambao wako tayari kulipa pesa nyingi kwa haki ya kufika mahali kwa haraka na kwa starehe, na wanabadilisha ipasavyo.
translations.hypothesis: Kampuni za ndege zinaelewa vizuri kwamba kuna kikundi fulani la abiria ambao wako tayari kulipa bei kubwa ili kupata huduma ya kusafiri kwa kasi na kwa urahisi, na hivyo, watoa bei kulingana na hilo.

translations.source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.reference: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chisinau. Lugha ya ndani ni Kiroma, lakini Kirusi inatumika sana.
translations.hypothesis: Mji mkuu wa Moldova ni Chişinău. Lugha ya eneo ni Romania, lakini lugha ya Kirusi hutumika sana.

translations.source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.reference: Moldova ni taifa lenye makabila mngi ambayo yameteseka kutokana na migogoro ya kikabila.
translations.hypothesis: Moldova ni jamhuri yenye vyoo vyote, ambayo imekumbana na migogoro za kitaifa.

translations.source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.reference: Mnamo 1994, migogoro hii ilipelekea kuundwa na kujitangaza kwa Taifa la Transnistria mashariki mwa Moldova, ambalo lina serikali na sarafu yake, lakini halitambuliwa na taifa lolote wanachama wa Umoja wa Mataifa.
translations.hypothesis: Mnamo 1994, mgogoro huu ulisababisha utawala wa Transnistria, ambayo ilitangazwa kuwa jamii, katika kaskazini mwa Moldova. Jamii hii ina serikali na matafa, lakini si rasmi na vyama vyote vya Umoja wa Mataifa.

translations.source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.reference: Viungo vya kiuchumi vimeanzishwa tena kati ya sehemu hizi mbili za Moldova licha ya kutofaulu kwa majadiliano ya kisiasa.
translations.hypothesis: Miungano za kiuchumi zimeimarishwa tena kati ya sehemu hizi mbili za Moldova, licha ya kushindwa katika mazungumzo ya kisiasa.

translations.source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.reference: Dini kuu katika Moldova ni Ukristo wa Kiorthodoksi.
translations.hypothesis: Dini kuu katika Moldova ni Ufariki.

translations.source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.reference: Izmir ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Uturuki na idadi ya watu ya takribani milioni 3.7, bandari ya pili kwa ukubwa baada ya Istanbul, na kitovu kizuri sana cha uchukuzi.
translations.hypothesis: İzmir ni mji wa tatu kwa ukubwa nchini Turkey, na idadi ya wakazi ni takriban 3.7 milioni, ni bandari kubwa ya pili baada ya Istanbul, na ni kituo muhimu cha usafiri.

translations.source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.reference: Uliokuwa mji wa kale wa Smyma, sasa ni wa kisasa, ulioendelea, na wa kibiashara wenye shughuli nyingi, ulioewekwa kuzunguka kituo kikubwa na umezungukwa na milima.
translations.hypothesis: Hapo awali, ilikuwa jiji la kale la Smyrna, lakini sasa ni kitovu cha kisasa, kilichoendelezwa, na cha sanaa, ambapo kiko katika mto kubwa na kiko المحاط na milima.

translations.source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.reference: Njia pana, majengo yenye vioo sehemu za mbele na vituo vya kisasa vya kibiashara vimejaa paa za vigae vyekundu vya jadi, soko la karne ya 18, misikiti na makanisa ya zamani, ingawa jiji lenyewe lina anga ya Uropa kuliko Uturuki ya jadi.
translations.hypothesis: الشارع kuu, majengo yenye madirisha, na vituo vya upato vya kisasa, yanaambatana na nyumba za rangi nyekundu, sokoni la karne ya 18, na masoko na kanisa za kale, licha ya kwamba jiji hilo lina mazingira zaidi ya Ulaya ya Mediterania kuliko Uturuki ya asili.

translations.source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.reference: Kijiji cha Haldarsvik kina mtazamo wa kisiwa kilicho karibu cha Eysturoi na kina kanisa lenye umbo lisilo la kawaida la pembe nane.
translations.hypothesis: Kijiji cha Haldarsvík hutoa mandhari nzuri za kisiwa jirani, Eysturoy, na pia ina kanisa la kipekee, la aina ya octagon.

translations.source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.reference: Katika uwanja wa kanisa, kuna vinyago vya kuvutia vya marumaru vya njiwa juu ya kaburi.
translations.hypothesis: Katika eneo la kanisa, kuna ukumbusho za marma za punda za kuvutia, ambazo zimefanywa juu ya kaburi za mawe.

translations.source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.reference: Inafaa nusu saa kutembeatembea katika kijiji hicho ambacho kinavutia.
translations.hypothesis: Ni ghali zaidi ya dakika 30 kutumia muda katika utulivu wa kijiji hili.

translations.source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.reference: Upande wa kaskazini na mahali rahisi kufika kuna mji wa mahaba na wa kuvutia, uliofanywa maarufu na wageni baada ya kusimulia mapambo yake ya kung'aa kama yalivyorekodiwa na Lord Byron.
translations.hypothesis: Kaskazini, na katika eneo rahisi, kuna mji wa Sintra ambao ni wa kuvutia na wa ajabu. Mji huu ulipopata umaarufu miongoni mwa wageni baada ya hadithi nzuri kuhusu uzuri lake, iliyoandikwa na Lord Byron.

translations.source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Basi la Skotabu 403 husafiri mara kwa mara hadi Sintra, na kusimama Kabo da Roka.
translations.hypothesis: Bas na Scotturb, namba 403, huendesha safari mara kwa mara kwenda Sintra, na hupa marudio katika Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.reference: Pia upande wa kaskazini tembelea Hekalu la Mama Yetu Fatima (Madhabahu), mahali maarufu duniani pa maonyesho ya Maria.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, kaskazini, tembelea "Sanctuary ya Bado Maria wa Fatima" (Mwalimu), ambayo ni eneo maarufu duniani kwa maono za Maria.

translations.source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.reference: Tafadhali kumbuka kuwa hasa unatembelea mahali penye kaburi la watu wengi, na pia mahali ambapo pana maana isiyoweza kutabiriwa kwa sehemu kubwa ya idadi ya watu ulimwenguni.
translations.hypothesis: Tafadhali kumbuka kwamba, kwa kweli, unafika katika eneo la makaburiko, na pia eneo ambalo lina maana kubwa kwa sehemu kubwa ya idadi ya watu duniani.

translations.source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.reference: Kungali kuna wanaume na wanawake wengi walio hai walioishi muda wao hapa, na wengine wengi ambao wapendwa wao waliuawa au walifanyishwa kazi hadi kufa, Wayahudi na wasio Wayahudi vilevile.
translations.hypothesis: Bado kuna watao wengi, wanaume na wanawake, ambao bado wameishi, na wengine wengi ambao walikuwa na familia, ambazo zilitoweka au zilitumika hadi kufa, pamoja na Yahudi na wasio-Yahudi.

translations.source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.reference: Tafadhali tendea mahali hapo kwa hadhi yote, utaratibu na heshima inayostahiki. Usifanye utani juu ya Maangamizo au Wanazi.
translations.hypothesis: Tafadhali, tafadhali kutumia eneo hilo kwa heshima, umaridho, na heshima inayostahili. Usifanye majaribio kuhusu Holocaust au Wajerumani.

translations.source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.reference: Usiumbue tovuti kwa kuashiria au kukata michoro kwenye miundo.
translations.hypothesis: Usiharibu eneo hilo kwa kuandika au kuchora graffiti kwenye majengo.

translations.source: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.reference: Lugha rasmi za Baselona Kikatalani na Kihispania. Takribani nusu yao wanapendelea kuongea Kikatalani, idadi kubwa wanaielewa, na karibu kila mtu anajua Kihispania.
translations.hypothesis: Lingo rasmi la Barcelona ni Catalan na Kichwa. Kimsingi, karibu nusu wanapendelea kuzungumza Catalan, wengi wengi wanaelewa, na karibu kila mtu anaweza kuzungumza Kichwa.

translations.source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, ishara nyingi huonyeshwa kwa Kikatalani kwa sababu imewekwa kisheria kama lugha rasmi ya kwanza.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, alama nyingi zinaonyeshwa tu kwa Ki-Catalan, kwa sababu ni lugha rasmi ya kwanza, na hivyo ni sheria.

translations.source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.reference: Kihispania bado hutumika sana katika uchukuzi wa umma na maeneo mengine.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, Kiingereza pia hutumika sana katika usafiri wa umma na katika vituo vingine.

translations.source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.reference: Matangazo ya mara kwa mara katika Metro hufanywa tu kwa Kitalani, lakini usumbufu usiopangwa hutangazwa kwa mifumo otomatiki kwa kutumia lugha mbalimbali zikiwemo Kihispania, Kiingereza, Kifaransa, Kiarabu na Kijapanisi.
translations.hypothesis: Taarifa za mara kwa mara katika Metro hufanyika tu kwa lugha ya Catalan, lakini matatizo isiyo planned hutangazwa na mfumo wa moja kwa moja katika lugha mbalimbali, pamoja na Kijapani, Kiingereza, Kifaransa, Kiarabu, na Kispania.

translations.source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.reference: Waparisi wana sifa ya kujipenda, jeuri na wenye kiburi.
translations.hypothesis: Waturuki wana utaalamu wa kuwa watekelezaji, wasio na heshima, na wenye fahari nyingi.

translations.source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.reference: Wakati hii mara nyingi ni aina ya dhana tu isiyofaa, njia nzuri ya kupatana kule Paris bado ni kuwa katika tabia yako njema, kufanya kama mtu ambaye ni “bien e’lev’e” (amelelewa vizuri). Itafanya kupatana rahisi mno.
translations.hypothesis: Ingawa hii mara nyingi ni aina ya ubaguzi, njia bora ya kuishi vizuri huko Paris bado ni kuwa na tabia nzuri, na kuendesha tabia kama mtu ambaye amejitolea vizuri (ameolewa vizuri). Hii itafanya kuendesha maisha kuwa rahisi zaidi.

translations.source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.reference: Umbo za nje za ghafla za Parisiani zitayeyuka haraka ikiwa unaonyesha ustahifu kadhaa za kimsingi.
translations.hypothesis: Tabia za watu wa Paris zinaweza kubadilika haraka ikiwa utoonyesha niipendo na heshima.

translations.source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.reference: Mbuga ya Kitaifa ya Plitvice Lakes ina misitu sana, hususan mifune, misonobari, na miti ya misonobari, na mchanganyiko wa uoto wa safu ya milima ya Alp na mediterania.
translations.hypothesis: Hifadhi ya kitaifa ya Maziwa ya Plitvice ni eneo lenye miti mengi, hasa miti ya beech, spruce, na fir, na ina mchanganyiko wa mimea za Alpine na za Mediterranean.

translations.source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.reference: Ina aina anuwai za jamii za mimea, kutokana na masafa yake ya hali ndogondogo za anga, mchanga tofauti na kutofautiana kwa viwango vya urefu.
translations.hypothesis: Ina aina kubwa ya jamii za miti, kwa sababu ya mambo mbalimbali kama vile hali ya hewa, virutubisho tofauti, na viwango tofauti vya kimo.

translations.source: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.reference: Eneo hilo pia ni nyumbani mwa aina nyingi sana mbalimbali za spishi za wanyama na ndege.
translations.hypothesis: eneo hilo pia ni nyumbani kwa aina kubwa sana za viumbe na ndege.

translations.source: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.reference: Wanyama nadra kama vile Dubu wa hudhurungi wa Ulaya, mbwa mwitu, tai, bundi, simba-mangu, paka mwitu na kware wa Ulaya wanaweza kupatikana huko, pamoja na spishi nyingine nyingi za kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: Viumbe nadra kama simba wa kijani wa Ulaya, shuh, vifarasi, mbwa, lynx, paka wa pori, na capercaillie, pamoja na spishi nyingi zingine za kawaida, yanaweza kupatikana huko.

translations.source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.reference: Wakati wa kutembelea nyumba za watawa, wanawake wanatarajiwa kuvaa sketi zinazofunika magoti na pia wafunike mabega yao.
translations.hypothesis: Huku wakijiuliza katika vyumba, wanawake wanatakiwa kuvaa nguo ambazo hufunika viungo na pia, wanatakiwa kuwa na nguo ambazo hufunika shingo zao.

translations.source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.reference: Nyingi za monasteri hutoa kanga kwa wanawake wanaokuja bila, lakini ukija na kanga yako, haswa iliyo na rangi kali, utapata tabasamu kutoka kwa monaki au sista kwenye kiingilio.
translations.hypothesis: Kama kawaida, karibu na vyumba vya ibada, kuna vifaa vya kuvalia kwa wanawake, lakini ikiwa una vifaa zako mwenyewe, hasa kama ni vya rangi nzuri, utapata ponge kutoka kwa askari au mwanamke wa kanisa.

translations.source: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.reference: Vile vile, wanaume wanahitajika kuvaa suruali zinazofunika magoti.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, wanaume wanapaswa kuvaa mitungi ambayo yanazi, ili kuzoeza viungo.

translations.source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.reference: Hii pia inaweza kuombwa kutoka kwa akiba kwenye lango lakini nguo hizo hazifuliwi baada ya kila mtumiaji kwa hivyo huenda usijihisi mwenye starehe unapovaa sketi hizo. Saizi moja hutosha wote kwa wanaume!
translations.hypothesis: Hii pia inaweza kuchukuliwa kutoka kwenye hisa kwenye eneo la ndani, lakini nguo hizi hazafugwa baada ya kila mtu kutumia, hivyo unaweza kuwa hauna raha kuzivumia. Ukubwa moja inafaa kwa wote wanaume!

translations.source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.reference: Vyakula vya Majokan, kama vile vya sehemu nyingine kwenye kanda ya bahari ya Mediterranean, vimetengenezwa kwa mkate, mboga na nyama (hasa ya nguruwe), na hutumia mafuta ya mizeituni nyakati zote.
translations.hypothesis: Upishi wa Majorca, kama wa eneo la kawaida katika Mediterania, una msingi katika mkate, mboga na nyama (hasa nyama ya pigi), na hutumia mafuta ya zambarau katika kila aina ya vyombo.

translations.source: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.reference: Chakula rahisi cha jioni, hasa wakati wa kiangazi, huwa ni Pa ambi Oli: Mkate wa mafuta ya mizeituni, nyanya, na viungo vingine vinavyopatikana kama vile jibini na samakituna.
translations.hypothesis: وجبة ya kila siku na maarufu, hasa wakati wa majira ya joto, ni "Pa amb Oli": mkate na mafuta ya oli, mboga ya kamandi, na viungo zingine zinazopatikana kama vile jibini, samaki, nk.

translations.source: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.reference: Nomino zote, ikiwemo Sie kwa wewe, daima huanza kwa herufi kubwa, hata katika katikati mwa sentensi.
translations.hypothesis: Kila neno, pamoja na neno "Sie" (kwako), daima huanza na herufi kubwa, hata katikati ya sentensi.

translations.source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.reference: Hii ni njia muhimu ya kutofautisha kati ya baadhi ya vitenzi na vitu.
translations.hypothesis: Hii ni njia muhimu ya kutofauti kati ya verb na vitu fulani.

translations.source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.reference: Pia bila shaka inafanya kusoma rahisi, ingawa kuandika kwa kiasi fulani ni ngumu kwa haja ya kutaka kujua kama kitenzi au kivumishi kinatumika kwa umuhimu.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, inaweza kufanya kusoma kuwa rahisi, lakini kuandika inaweza kuwa ngumu, kwa sababu inahitaji kujua kama verb au adjective hutumika katika mfumo wa nouni.

translations.source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.reference: Matamshi ni rahisi kiasi kwa Kiitaliano kwani maneno mengi hutamkwa hasa yalivyoandikwa
translations.hypothesis: Kiambatisho ni rahisi katika lugha ya Italia, kwani karibu maneno yote hutamuliwa kwa njia ambayo yameandikwa.

translations.source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.reference: Herufi muhimu za kuzingatia ni c na g, kwani matamshi yake hubadilika kulingana na vokali inayofuata.
translations.hypothesis: Hurufi kuu ambazo unapaswa kuwa macho ni "c" na "g", kwani sauti zao zinabadilika kulingana na swali inayofuata.

translations.source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.reference: Pia, hakikisha kutamka r na rr tofauti: caro inamaanisha mpenzi, ilhali carro inamaanisha gari la kuvurutwa na farasi.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, hakikisha unautumia vifungu "r" na "rr" kwa njia tofauti: "caro" inamaanisha "mpendwa", wakati "carro" inamaanisha "gari".

translations.source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.reference: Kiajemi ina sarufi rahisi kiasi, na mara nyingi ya kawaida.
translations.hypothesis: Kiperisiano kina mtindo wa grama ambao ni rahisi na kwa kawaida una sheria za kawaida.

translations.source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.reference: Kwa hivyo, kusoma chanzo hiki cha sarufi kutakusaidia wewe kujifunza mengi kuhusu sarufi ya Kiajemi na kuelewa bora zaidi.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa hiyo, kusoma mwongozo huu wa grama, itakusaidia kujifunza mengi kuhusu grama ya Kifaransa na kuelewa maneno vizuri.

translations.source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.reference: Bila haja ya kusema, ikiwa unaifahamu lugha ya mahaba, itakuwa rahisi kwako kujifunza Kireno.
translations.hypothesis: Hakika, ikiwa una maarifa ya lugha ya Kifaransa, itakuwa rahisi zaidi kwako kujifunza lugha ya Kireno.

translations.source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.reference: Hata hivyo, watu wanaofahamu Kihispania kidogo wanaweza kuhitimisha kwa haraka kuwa Kireno kinakaribiana sana na kwamba hakihitaji kusomwa kando.
translations.hypothesis: Hata hivyo, watu ambao wana maarifa kidogo ya Kiaspania, wanaweza kufanya hitimisho kwamba Kireno ni sawa, hivyo hakuna haja ya kujifunza kwa ajili yake.

translations.source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.reference: Uchunguzi kabla ya kisasa kwa kawaida hautumiki leo, na hubaki kama makavazi, ama sehemu za elimu.
translations.hypothesis: مراכזo za utambuzi za kale, kwa kawaida hazitumika tena leo, na bado zimepotea kama maonyesho, au kama maeneo ya elimu.

translations.source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.reference: Kwani uchafuzi wa mwanga nyakati zao haukuwa shida kama ilivyo leo, mara nyingi wako mijini au katikavyuo vikuu, rahisi kufikia kuliko zile zimejengwa siku za kisasa.
translations.hypothesis: Haya majengo, wakati walikuwa katika hali nzuri, hawakuwa tatizo kama zile leo. Kwa kawaida, ziko katika miji au katika vyuo vikuu, na ni rahisi kufika, ikilinganishwa na zile zilizojengwa katika enzi za kisasa.

translations.source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Darubini nyingi za utafiti za kisasa ni vifaa kuu katika maeneo ya mbali yaliyo na hali nzuri za angahewa.
translations.hypothesis: Vifaa vya utafiti vya kisasa zaidi ni majengo kubwa katika maeneo farini, ambapo hali ya hewa ni nzuri.

translations.source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.reference: Utazamaji wa maua ya cheri, inayojulikana kama hanami, imekuwa sehemu ya utamaduni wa Kijapani tangu karne ya 8.
translations.hypothesis: Uzoefu wa kutazama maua ya cherry, inayojulikana kama "hanami", ni sehemu ya utamaduni wa Kijapani tangu karne ya 8.

translations.source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.reference: Dhana hiyo ilitoka Uchina ambapo maua ya plamu ndiyo yaliyokuwa maua yaliyopendelewa.
translations.hypothesis: Mconcepto ulitoka China, ambapo maua ya plum yalikuwa maua maarufu.

translations.source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.reference: Huko Japani, sherehe za kwanza za maua ya mcheri ziliandaliwa na maliki kwa ajili yake mwenyewe na washiriki wengine wa upatanishi waliozunguka Mahakama ya Imperi.
translations.hypothesis: Nchini Japan, sherehe za kwanza za maua ya sakura ziliendeshwa na mfalme, kwa ajili yake na wanachama wengine wa familia mfalme.

translations.source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.reference: Mimea inaonekana bora ikiwa katika mazingira ya asili, kwa hivyo epuka kishawishi cha kutoa hata kiolezo "kimoja tu".
translations.hypothesis: Maua na miti zinaonekana vizuri zaidi katika mazingira asilia, kwa hivyo, jiuzwe kutoka kwa hamu ya kuondoa hata "moja tu".

translations.source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.reference: Ikiwa unatembelea bustani iliyopangwa rasmi, kukusanya “violezo” pia kutakufanya uodolewe, bila majadiliano.
translations.hypothesis: Ikiwa unaenda katika bustani iliyojengwa, kukusanya "sampuli" pia itakuwa sababu ya kukutolewa, bila taarifa.

translations.source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.reference: Singapori kwa ujumla ni mahali salama zaidi kuwa na rahisi sana kuabiri, na unaweza kununua karibu chochote baada ya kuwasili.
translations.hypothesis: Singapuru kwa ujumla ni eneo la salama sana na rahisi sana, na unaweza kununua kila kitu baada ya kuwasili.

translations.source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.reference: Lakini kwa kuwekwa katika “tropiki za juu” digrii chache tu kaskazini mwa istiwai utahitaji kukabiliana na joto jingi (kila wakati) na jua kali (wakati anga ni safi, nadra zaidi).
translations.hypothesis: Lakini kuwa katika "eneo la tropiki la juu", ambayo ni takriban hatua chache kaskazini ya ekwator, unahitaji kuzingatia joto (daima) na jua kali (ambapo anga ni wazi, lakini nadra).

translations.source: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.reference: Pia kuna mabasi machache yanayoelekea kaskazini mwa Hebroni, mahali pa makaburi ya jadi ya mashujaa wa Biblia Abrahamu, Isaka, Yakobo, na wake zao.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, kuna vyumba kadhaa ambavyo huenda kaskazini kwenda Hebron, ambayo ni eneo la kale la kuanzishwa, ambapo Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, na wao wazawa walikuwa wanaanzishwa.

translations.source: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.reference: Hakikisha kwamba basi unalofikiria kuabiri linaenda Hebron na si katika makazi ya karibu ya Kiyahudi ya Kiryat Arba tu.
translations.hypothesis: Hakikisha kwamba basi ambao una nia ya kumeza, unaenda katika eneo la Hebron, na si tu katika makazi ya Yahudi ya karibu, ya Kiryat Arba.

translations.source: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.reference: Njia za maji za barani zinaweza kuwa mandhari mzuri ya kufanyia likizo.
translations.hypothesis: Maji ya ndani yanaweza kuwa mada nzuri kwa ajili ya kupanga likizo.

translations.source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.reference: Kwa mfano, kutembelea ngome katika Bonde la Loire, Bonde la Rhine au kusafiri katika maeneo ya kuvutia kwa Danube au kusafiri kwa mashua upande wa Mfereji wa Erie.
translations.hypothesis: Kwa mfano, kutembelea majumba katika eneo la Loire, eneo la Rhine, au kuchukua safari ya meli hadi miji za kuvutia kwenye mto Danube, au kukimbia kwenye njia ya maji ya Erie.

translations.source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.reference: Pia wao hufafanua njia maarufu za matembezi na uendeshaji baiskeli.
translations.hypothesis: Pia, wanaweka njia za umalizi kwa njia maarufu za kukimbia na kupumua.

translations.source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.reference: Krismasi ni moja ya likizo muhimu zaidi ya Ukristo, na inaadhimishwa kama siku ya kuzaliwa kwa Yesu.
translations.hypothesis: Kufanya Krismasi ni mojawapo ya likizo muhimu za Ufariki, na hutangazwa kama siku ya kuzaliwa kwa Yesu.

translations.source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.reference: Nyingi za tamaduni zinazozunguka likizo zimesilikwa pia na wasioamini katika nchi za Kikristo na wasio Wakristo duniani kote.
translations.hypothesis: Watazo nyingi zinazohusiana na siku hiyo, pia zimepata umaarufu katika nchi ambapo watu hawana imani na Uislamu, na katika nchi za dunia nzima.

translations.source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.reference: Kuna desturi ya kukesha usiku wa Pasaka katika sehemu fulani wazi ili kuona jua likichomoza.
translations.hypothesis: Kuna utamaduni wa kuishi usiku wa Pasaka akiwa amefunguka, katika eneo ambapo unaweza kuona jua lishangaa.

translations.source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.reference: Kwa kweli kuna maelezo ya thiolojia ya Kikristo ya utamaduni huu, lakini pia huenda ikawa ibada ya Majira ya kuchipua na Uzazi kabla ya Ukristo.
translations.hypothesis: Hakika, kuna maelezo ya kanisa kuhusu utamaduni huu, lakini inaweza kuwa tamaduni ya Maua na uzazi kabla ya Uislamu.

translations.source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.reference: Makanisa zaidi ya jadi huwa na Mkesha wa Pasaka usiku wa Jumamosi wakati wa wikendi ya Pasaka, waumini wakisherehekea saa sita kamili za usiku kuadhimisha ufufuo wa Kristo.
